94.s: אֵל־נְקָמוֹת יְהוָה אֵל נְקָמוֹת הוֹפִיַע׃
94.e: O LORD, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, Thou God to whom vengeance belongeth, shine forth.

94.s: הִנָּשֵׂא שֹׁפֵט הָאָרֶץ הָשֵׁב גְּמוּל עַל־גֵּאִים׃
94.e: Lift up Thyself, Thou Judge of the earth; Render to the proud their recompense.

94.s: עַד־מָתַי רְשָׁעִים יְהוָה עַד־מָתַי רְשָׁעִים יַעֲלֹזוּ׃
94.e: LORD, how long shall the wicked, How long shall the wicked exult?

94.s: יַבִּיעוּ יְדַבְּרוּ עָתָק יִתְאַמְּרוּ כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
94.e: They gush out, they speak arrogancy; All the workers of iniquity bear themselves loftily.

94.s: עַמְּךָ יְהוָה יְדַכְּאוּ וְנַחֲלָתְךָ יְעַנּוּ׃
94.e: They crush Thy people, O LORD, And afflict Thy heritage.

94.s: אַלְמָנָה וְגֵר יַהֲרֹגוּ וִיתוֹמִים יְרַצֵּחוּ׃
94.e: They slay the widow and the stranger, And murder the fatherless.

94.s: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא יִרְאֶה־יָּהּ וְלֹא־יָבִין אֱלֹהֵי יַעֲקֹב׃
94.e: And they say: 'The LORD will not see, Neither will the God of Jacob give heed.'

94.s: בִּינוּ בֹּעֲרִים בָּעָם וּכְסִילִים מָתַי תַּשְׂכִּילוּ׃
94.e: Consider, ye brutish among the people; And ye fools, when will ye understand?

94.s: הֲנֹטַע אֹזֶן הֲלֹא יִשְׁמָע אִם־יֹצֵר עַיִן הֲלֹא יַבִּיט׃
94.e: He that planted the ear, shall He not hear? He that formed the eye, shall He not see?

94.s: הֲיֹסֵר גּוֹיִם הֲלֹא יוֹכִיחַ הַמְלַמֵּד אָדָם דָּעַת׃
94.e: He that instructeth nations, shall not He correct? Even He that teacheth man knowledge?

94.s: יְהוָה יֹדֵעַ מַחְשְׁבוֹת אָדָם כִּי־הֵמָּה הָבֶל׃
94.e: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, That they are vanity.

94.s: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר־תְּיַסְּרֶנּוּ יָּהּ וּמִתּוֹרָתְךָ תְלַמְּדֶנּוּ׃
94.e: Happy is the man whom Thou instructest, O LORD, And teachest out of Thy law;

94.s: לְהַשְׁקִיט לוֹ מִימֵי רָע עַד יִכָּרֶה לָרָשָׁע שָׁחַת׃
94.e: That Thou mayest give him rest from the days of evil, Until the pit be digged for the wicked.

94.s: כִּי לֹא־יִטֹּשׁ יְהוָה עַמּוֹ וְנַחֲלָתוֹ לֹא יַעֲזֹב׃
94.e: For the LORD will not cast off His people, Neither will He forsake His inheritance.

94.s: כִּי־עַד־צֶדֶק יָשׁוּב מִשְׁפָּט וְאַחֲרָיו כָּל־יִשְׁרֵי־לֵב׃
94.e: For right shall return unto justice, And all the upright in heart shall follow it.

94.s: מִי־יָקוּם לִי עִם־מְרֵעִים מִי־יִתְיַצֵּב לִי עִם־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
94.e: Who will rise up for me against the evil-doers? Who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

94.s: לוּלֵי יְהוָה עֶזְרָתָה לִּי כִּמְעַט שָׁכְנָה דוּמָה נַפְשִׁי׃
94.e: Unless the LORD had been my help, My soul had soon dwelt in silence.

94.s: אִם־אָמַרְתִּי מָטָה רַגְלִי חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה יִסְעָדֵנִי׃
94.e: If I say: 'My foot slippeth', Thy mercy, O LORD, holdeth me up.

94.s: בְּרֹב שַׂרְעַפַּי בְּקִרְבִּי תַּנְחוּמֶיךָ יְשַׁעַשְׁעוּ נַפְשִׁי׃
94.e: When my cares are many within me, Thy comforts delight my soul.

94.s: הַיְחָבְרְךָ כִּסֵּא הַוּוֹת יֹצֵר עָמָל עֲלֵי־חֹק׃
94.e: Shall the seat of wickedness have fellowship with Thee, Which frameth mischief by statute?

94.s: יָגוֹדּוּ עַל־נֶפֶשׁ צַדִּיק וְדָם נָקִי יַרְשִׁיעוּ׃
94.e: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, And condemn innocent blood.

94.s: וַיְהִי יְהוָה לִי לְמִשְׂגָּב וֵאלֹהַי לְצוּר מַחְסִי׃
94.e: But the LORD hath been my high tower, And my God the rock of my refuge.

94.s: וַיָּשֶׁב עֲלֵיהֶם אֶת־אוֹנָם וּבְרָעָתָם יַצְמִיתֵם יַצְמִיתֵם יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
94.e: And He hath brought upon them their own iniquity, And will cut them off in their own evil; The LORD our God will cut them off.

95.s: לְכוּ נְרַנְּנָה לַיהוָה נָרִיעָה לְצוּר יִשְׁעֵנוּ׃
95.e: O come, let us sing unto the LORD; Let us shout for joy to the Rock of our salvation.

95.s: נְקַדְּמָה פָנָיו בְּתוֹדָה בִּזְמִרוֹת נָרִיעַ לוֹ׃
95.e: Let us come before His presence with thanksgiving, Let us shout for joy unto Him with psalms.

95.s: כִּי אֵל גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמֶלֶךְ גָּדוֹל עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
95.e: For the LORD is a great God, And a great King above all gods;

95.s: אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי־אָרֶץ וְתוֹעֲפוֹת הָרִים לוֹ׃
95.e: In whose hand are the depths of the earth; The heights of the mountains are His also.

95.s: אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ הַיָּם וְהוּא עָשָׂהוּ וְיַבֶּשֶׁת יָדָיו יָצָרוּ׃
95.e: The sea is His, and He made it; And His hands formed the dry land.

95.s: בֹּאוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה וְנִכְרָעָה נִבְרְכָה לִפְנֵי־יְהוָה עֹשֵׂנוּ׃
95.e: O come, let us bow down and bend the knee; Let us kneel before the LORD our Maker;

95.s: כִּי הוּא אֱלֹהֵינוּ וַאֲנַחְנוּ עַם מַרְעִיתוֹ וְצֹאן יָדוֹ הַיּוֹם אִם־בְּקֹלוֹ תִשְׁמָעוּ׃
95.e: For He is our God, And we are the people of His pasture, and the flock of His hand. To-day, if ye would but hearken to His voice!

95.s: אַל־תַּקְשׁוּ לְבַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָה כְּיוֹם מַסָּה בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
95.e: 'Harden not your heart, as at Meribah, As in the day of Massah in the wilderness;

95.s: אֲשֶׁר נִסּוּנִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶם בְּחָנוּנִי גַּם־רָאוּ פָעֳלִי׃
95.e: When your fathers tried Me, Proved Me, even though they saw My work.

95.s: אַרְבָּעִים שָׁנָה אָקוּט בְּדוֹר וָאֹמַר עַם תֹּעֵי לֵבָב הֵם וְהֵם לֹא־יָדְעוּ דְרָכָי׃
95.e: For forty years was I wearied with that generation, And said: It is a people that do err in their heart, And they have not known My ways;
Wherefore I swore in My wrath, That they should not enter into My rest.'

96.s: שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
96.e: O sing unto the LORD a new song; Sing unto the LORD, all the earth.

96.s: שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה בָּרֲכוּ שְׁמוֹ בַּשְּׂרוּ מִיּוֹם־לְיוֹם יְשׁוּעָתוֹ׃
96.e: Sing unto the LORD, bless His name; Proclaim His salvation from day to day.
Declare His glory among the nations, His marvellous works among all the peoples.

96.s: כִּי גָדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד נוֹרָא הוּא עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
96.e: For great is the LORD, and highly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods. .

96.s: כִּי כָּל־אֱלֹהֵי הָעַמִּים אֱלִילִים וַיהוָה שָׁמַיִם עָשָׂה׃
96.e: For all the gods of the peoples are things of nought; But the LORD made the heavens.
Honour and majesty are before Him; Strength and beauty are in His sanctuary.

96.s: הָבוּ לַיהוָה מִשְׁפְּחוֹת עַמִּים הָבוּ לַיהוָה כָּבוֹד וָעֹז׃
96.e: Ascribe unto the LORD, ye kindreds of the peoples, Ascribe unto the LORD glory and strength.

96.s: הָבוּ לַיהוָה כְּבוֹד שְׁמוֹ שְׂאוּ־מִנְחָה וּבֹאוּ לְחַצְרוֹתָיו׃
96.e: Ascribe unto the LORD the glory due unto His name; Bring an offering, and come into His courts.

96.s: הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַיהוָה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹדֶשׁ חִילוּ מִפָּנָיו כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
96.e: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness; Tremble before Him, all the earth.

96.s: אִמְרוּ בַגּוֹיִם יְהוָה מָלָךְ אַף־תִּכּוֹן תֵּבֵל בַּל־תִּמּוֹט יָדִין עַמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים׃
96.e: Say among the nations: 'The LORD reigneth.' The world also is established that it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.

96.s: יִשְׂמְחוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם וְתָגֵל הָאָרֶץ יִרְעַם הַיָּם וּמְלֹאוֹ׃
96.e: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof;

96.s: יַעֲלֹז שָׂדַי וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בּוֹ אָז יְרַנְּנוּ כָּל־עֲצֵי־יָעַר׃
96.e: Let the field exult; and all that is therein; Then shall all the trees of the wood sing for joy;

96.s: לִפְנֵי יְהוָה כִּי בָא כִּי בָא לִשְׁפֹּט הָאָרֶץ יִשְׁפֹּט־תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק וְעַמִּים בֶּאֱמוּנָתוֹ׃
96.e: Before the LORD, for He is come; For He is come to judge the earth; He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples in His faithfulness.

97.s: יְהוָה מָלָךְ תָּגֵל הָאָרֶץ יִשְׂמְחוּ אִיִּים רַבִּים׃
97.e: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; Let the multitude of isles be glad.

97.s: עָנָן וַעֲרָפֶל סְבִיבָיו צֶדֶק וּמִשְׁפָּט מְכוֹן כִּסְאוֹ׃
97.e: Clouds and darkness are round about Him; Righteousness and justice are the foundation of His throne.

97.s: אֵשׁ לְפָנָיו תֵּלֵךְ וּתְלַהֵט סָבִיב צָרָיו׃
97.e: A fire goeth before Him, And burneth up His adversaries round about.

97.s: הֵאִירוּ בְרָקָיו תֵּבֵל רָאֲתָה וַתָּחֵל הָאָרֶץ׃
97.e: His lightnings lighted up the world; The earth saw, and trembled.

97.s: הָרִים כַּדּוֹנַג נָמַסּוּ מִלִּפְנֵי יְהוָה מִלִּפְנֵי אֲדוֹן כָּל־הָאָרֶץ׃
97.e: The mountains melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, At the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

97.s: הִגִּידוּ הַשָּׁמַיִם צִדְקוֹ וְרָאוּ כָל־הָעַמִּים כְּבוֹדוֹ׃
97.e: The heavens declared His righteousness, And all the peoples saw His glory.

97.s: יֵבֹשׁוּ כָּל־עֹבְדֵי פֶסֶל הַמִּתְהַלְלִים בָּאֱלִילִים הִשְׁתַּחֲווּ־לוֹ כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
97.e: Ashamed be all they that serve graven images, That boast themselves of things of nought; Bow down to Him, all ye gods.

97.s: שָׁמְעָה וַתִּשְׂמַח צִיּוֹן וַתָּגֵלְנָה בְּנוֹת יְהוּדָה לְמַעַן מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ יְהוָה׃
97.e: Zion heard and was glad, And the daughters of Judah rejoiced; Because of Thy judgments, O LORD.

97.s: כִּי־אַתָּה יְהוָה עֶלְיוֹן עַל־כָּל־הָאָרֶץ מְאֹד נַעֲלֵיתָ עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
97.e: For Thou, LORD, art most high above all the earth; Thou art exalted far above all gods.

97.s: אֹהֲבֵי יְהוָה שִׂנְאוּ רָע שֹׁמֵר נַפְשׁוֹת חֲסִידָיו מִיַּד רְשָׁעִים יַצִּילֵם׃
97.e: O ye that love the LORD, hate evil; He preserveth the souls of His saints; He delivered them out of the hand of the wicked.
Light is sown for the righteous, And gladness for the upright in heart.

97.s: שִׂמְחוּ צַדִּיקִים בַּיהוָה וְהוֹדוּ לְזֵכֶר קָדְשׁוֹ׃
97.e: Be glad in the LORD, ye righteous; And give thanks to His holy name.

98.s: מִזְמוֹר שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ כִּי־נִפְלָאוֹת עָשָׂה הוֹשִׁיעָה־לּוֹ יְמִינוֹ וּזְרוֹעַ קָדְשׁוֹ׃
98.e: A Psalm. O sing unto the LORD a new song; For He hath done marvellous things; His right hand, and His holy arm, hath wrought salvation for Him.

98.s: הוֹדִיעַ יְהוָה יְשׁוּעָתוֹ לְעֵינֵי הַגּוֹיִם גִּלָּה צִדְקָתוֹ׃
98.e: The LORD hath made known His salvation; His righteousness hath He revealed in the sight of the nations.

98.s: זָכַר חַסְדּוֹ וֶאֱמוּנָתוֹ לְבֵית יִשְׂרָאֵל רָאוּ כָל־אַפְסֵי־אָרֶץ אֵת יְשׁוּעַת אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
98.e: He hath remembered His mercy and His faithfulness toward the house of Israel; All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

98.s: הָרִיעוּ לַיהוָה כָּל־הָאָרֶץ פִּצְחוּ וְרַנְּנוּ וְזַמֵּרוּ׃
98.e: Shout unto the LORD, all the earth; Break forth and sing for joy, yea, sing praises.

98.s: זַמְּרוּ לַיהוָה בְּכִנּוֹר בְּכִנּוֹר וְקוֹל זִמְרָה׃
98.e: Sing praises unto the LORD with the harp; With the harp and the voice of melody.

98.s: בַּחֲצֹצְרוֹת וְקוֹל שׁוֹפָר הָרִיעוּ לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ יְהוָה׃
98.e: With trumpets and sound of the horn Shout ye before the King, the LORD.

98.s: יִרְעַם הַיָּם וּמְלֹאוֹ תֵּבֵל וְיֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃
98.e: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein;
Let the floods clap their hands; Let the mountains sing for joy together;

98.s: לִפְנֵי־יְהוָה כִּי בָא לִשְׁפֹּט הָאָרֶץ יִשְׁפֹּט־תֵּבֵל בְּצֶדֶק וְעַמִּים בְּמֵישָׁרִים׃
98.e: Before the LORD, for He is come to judge the earth; He will judge the world with righteousness, And the peoples with equity.

99.s: יְהוָה מָלָךְ יִרְגְּזוּ עַמִּים יֹשֵׁב כְּרוּבִים תָּנוּט הָאָרֶץ׃
99.e: The LORD reigneth; let the peoples tremble; He is enthroned upon the cherubim; let the earth quake.

99.s: יְהוָה בְּצִיּוֹן גָּדוֹל וְרָם הוּא עַל־כָּל־הָעַמִּים׃
99.e: The LORD is great in Zion; And He is high above all the peoples.

99.s: יוֹדוּ שִׁמְךָ גָּדוֹל וְנוֹרָא קָדוֹשׁ הוּא׃
99.e: Let them praise Thy name as great and awful; Holy is He.

99.s: וְעֹז מֶלֶךְ מִשְׁפָּט אָהֵב אַתָּה כּוֹנַנְתָּ מֵישָׁרִים מִשְׁפָּט וּצְדָקָה בְּיַעֲקֹב אַתָּה עָשִׂיתָ׃
99.e: The strength also of the king who loveth justice— Thou hast established equity, Thou hast executed justice and righteousness in Jacob.

99.s: רוֹמְמוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לַהֲדֹם רַגְלָיו קָדוֹשׁ הוּא׃
99.e: Exalt ye the LORD our God, And prostrate yourselves at His footstool; Holy is He.

99.s: מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן בְּכֹהֲנָיו וּשְׁמוּאֵל בְּקֹרְאֵי שְׁמוֹ קֹרִאים אֶל־יְהוָה וְהוּא יַעֲנֵם׃
99.e: Moses and Aaron among His priests, And Samuel among them that call upon His name, Did call upon the LORD, and He answered them.

99.s: בְּעַמּוּד עָנָן יְדַבֵּר אֲלֵיהֶם שָׁמְרוּ עֵדֹתָיו וְחֹק נָתַן־לָמוֹ׃
99.e: He spoke unto them in the pillar of cloud; They kept His testimonies, and the statute that He gave them.

99.s: יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אַתָּה עֲנִיתָם אֵל נֹשֵׂא הָיִיתָ לָהֶם וְנֹקֵם עַל־עֲלִילוֹתָם׃
99.e: O LORD our God, Thou didst answer them; A forgiving God wast Thou unto them, Though Thou tookest vengeance of their misdeeds.

99.s: רוֹמְמוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְהִשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְהַר קָדְשׁוֹ כִּי־קָדוֹשׁ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
99.e: Exalt ye the LORD our God, And worship at His holy hill; For the LORD our God is holy.

100.e: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout unto the LORD, all the earth.

100.s: עִבְדוּ אֶת־יְהוָה בְּשִׂמְחָה בֹּאוּ לְפָנָיו בִּרְנָנָה׃
100.e: Serve the LORD with gladness; come before His presence with singing.

100.s: דְּעוּ כִּי־יְהוָה הוּא אֱלֹהִים הוּא־עָשָׂנוּ ולא [וְלוֹ] אֲנַחְנוּ עַמּוֹ וְצֹאן מַרְעִיתוֹ׃
100.e: Know ye that the LORD He is God; it is He that hath made us, and we are His, His people, and the flock of His pasture.

100.s: בֹּאוּ שְׁעָרָיו בְּתוֹדָה חֲצֵרֹתָיו בִּתְהִלָּה הוֹדוּ־לוֹ בָּרֲכוּ שְׁמוֹ׃
100.e: Enter into His gates with thanksgiving, and into His courts with praise; give thanks unto Him, and bless His name.

100.s: כִּי־טוֹב יְהֹוָה לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ וְעַד־דֹּר וָדֹר אֱמוּנָתוֹ׃
100.e: For the LORD is good; His mercy endureth for ever; and His faithfulness unto all generations.

101.s: לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר חֶסֶד־וּמִשְׁפָּט אָשִׁירָה לְךָ יְהוָה אֲזַמֵּרָה׃
101.e: A Psalm of David. I will sing of mercy and justice; unto Thee, O LORD, will I sing praises.

101.s: אַשְׂכִּילָה בְּדֶרֶךְ תָּמִים מָתַי תָּבוֹא אֵלָי אֶתְהַלֵּךְ בְּתָם־לְבָבִי בְּקֶרֶב בֵּיתִי׃
101.e: I will give heed unto the way of integrity; oh when wilt Thou come unto me? I will walk within my house in the integrity of my heart.

101.s: לֹא־אָשִׁית לְנֶגֶד עֵינַי דְּבַר־בְּלִיָּעַל עֲשֹׂה־סֵטִים שָׂנֵאתִי לֹא יִדְבַּק בִּי׃
101.e: I will set no base thing before mine eyes; I hate the doing of things crooked; it shall not cleave unto me.

101.s: לֵבָב עִקֵּשׁ יָסוּר מִמֶּנִּי רָע לֹא אֵדָע׃
101.e: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know no evil thing.

101.s: מלושני [מְלָשְׁנִי] בַסֵּתֶר רֵעֵהוּ אוֹתוֹ אַצְמִית גְּבַהּ־עֵינַיִם וּרְחַב לֵבָב אֹתוֹ לֹא אוּכָל׃
101.e: Whoso slandereth his neighbour in secret, him will I destroy; Whoso is haughty of eye and proud of heart, him will I not suffer.

101.s: עֵינַי בְּנֶאֶמְנֵי־אֶרֶץ לָשֶׁבֶת עִמָּדִי הֹלֵךְ בְּדֶרֶךְ תָּמִים הוּא יְשָׁרְתֵנִי׃
101.e: Mine eyes are upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he that walketh in a way of integrity, he shall minister unto me.

101.s: לֹא־יֵשֵׁב בְּקֶרֶב בֵּיתִי עֹשֵׂה רְמִיָּה דֹּבֵר שְׁקָרִים לֹא־יִכּוֹן לְנֶגֶד עֵינָי׃
101.e: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house; he that speaketh falsehood shall not be established before mine eyes.

101.s: לַבְּקָרִים אַצְמִית כָּל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ לְהַכְרִית מֵעִיר־יְהוָה כָּל־פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
101.e: Morning by morning will I destroy all the wicked of the land; to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the city of the LORD.

102.s: תְּפִלָּה לְעָנִי כִי־יַעֲטֹף וְלִפְנֵי יְהוָה יִשְׁפֹּךְ שִׂיחוֹ׃
102.e: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he fainteth, and poureth out his complaint before the LORD.

102.s: יְהוָה שִׁמְעָה תְפִלָּתִי וְשַׁוְעָתִי אֵלֶיךָ תָבוֹא׃
102.e: O LORD, hear my prayer, and let my cry come unto Thee.

102.s: אַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי בְּיוֹם צַר לִי הַטֵּה־אֵלַי אָזְנֶךָ בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא מַהֵר עֲנֵנִי׃
102.e: Hide not Thy face from me in the day of my distress; incline Thine ear unto me; in the day when I call answer me speedily.

102.s: כִּי־כָלוּ בְעָשָׁן יָמָי וְעַצְמוֹתַי כְּמוֹ־קֵד נִחָרוּ׃
102.e: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as a hearth.

102.s: הוּכָּה־כָעֵשֶׂב וַיִּבַשׁ לִבִּי כִּי־שָׁכַחְתִּי מֵאֲכֹל לַחְמִי׃
102.e: My heart is smitten like grass, and withered; for I forget to eat my bread.

102.s: מִקּוֹל אַנְחָתִי דָּבְקָה עַצְמִי לִבְשָׂרִי׃
102.e: By reason of the voice of my sighing My bones cleave to my flesh.

102.s: דָּמִיתִי לִקְאַת מִדְבָּר הָיִיתִי כְּכוֹס חֳרָבוֹת׃
102.e: I am like a pelican of the wilderness; I am become as an owl of the waste places.

102.s: שָׁקַדְתִּי וָאֶהְיֶה כְּצִפּוֹר בּוֹדֵד עַל־גָּג׃
102.e: I watch, and am become like a sparrow that is alone upon the housetop.

102.s: כָּל־הַיּוֹם חֵרְפוּנִי אוֹיְבָי מְהוֹלָלַי בִּי נִשְׁבָּעוּ׃
102.e: Mine enemies taunt me all the day; they that are mad against me do curse by me.

102.s: כִּי־אֵפֶר כַּלֶּחֶם אָכָלְתִּי וְשִׁקֻּוַי בִּבְכִי מָסָכְתִּי׃
102.e: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

102.s: מִפְּנֵי־זַעַמְךָ וְקִצְפֶּךָ כִּי נְשָׂאתַנִי וַתַּשְׁלִיכֵנִי׃
102.e: Because of Thine indignation and Thy wrath; for Thou hast taken me up, and cast me away.

102.s: יָמַי כְּצֵל נָטוּי וַאֲנִי כָּעֵשֶׂב אִיבָשׁ׃
102.e: My days are like a lengthening shadow; and I am withered like grass.

102.s: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם תֵּשֵׁב וְזִכְרְךָ לְדֹר וָדֹר׃
102.e: But Thou, O LORD, sittest enthroned for ever; and Thy name is unto all generations.

102.s: אַתָּה תָקוּם תְּרַחֵם צִיּוֹן כִּי־עֵת לְחֶנְנָהּ כִּי־בָא מוֹעֵד׃
102.e: Thou wilt arise, and have compassion upon Zion; for it is time to be gracious unto her, for the appointed time is come.

102.s: כִּי־רָצוּ עֲבָדֶיךָ אֶת־אֲבָנֶיהָ וְאֶת־עֲפָרָהּ יְחֹנֵנוּ׃
102.e: For Thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and love her dust.

102.s: וְיִירְאוּ גוֹיִם אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה וְכָל־מַלְכֵי הָאָרֶץ אֶת־כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃
102.e: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth Thy glory;

102.s: כִּי־בָנָה יְהוָה צִיּוֹן נִרְאָה בִּכְבוֹדוֹ׃
102.e: When the LORD hath built up Zion, when He hath appeared in His glory;

102.s: פָּנָה אֶל־תְּפִלַּת הָעַרְעָר וְלֹא־בָזָה אֶת־תְּפִלָּתָם׃
102.e: When He hath regarded the prayer of the destitute, And hath not despised their prayer.

102.s: תִּכָּתֶב זֹאת לְדוֹר אַחֲרוֹן וְעַם נִבְרָא יְהַלֶּל־יָהּ׃
102.e: This shall be written for the generation to come; And a people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.

102.s: כִּי־הִשְׁקִיף מִמְּרוֹם קָדְשׁוֹ יְהוָה מִשָּׁמַיִם אֶל־אֶרֶץ הִבִּיט׃
102.e: For He hath looked down from the height of His sanctuary; From heaven did the LORD behold the earth;

102.s: לִשְׁמֹעַ אֶנְקַת אָסִיר לְפַתֵּחַ בְּנֵי תְמוּתָה׃
102.e: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; To loose those that are appointed to death;

102.s: לְסַפֵּר בְּצִיּוֹן שֵׁם יְהוָה וּתְהִלָּתוֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃
102.e: That men may tell of the name of the LORD in Zion, And His praise in Jerusalem; .

102.s: בְּהִקָּבֵץ עַמִּים יַחְדָּו וּמַמְלָכוֹת לַעֲבֹד אֶת־יְהוָה׃
102.e: When the peoples are gathered together, And the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

102.s: עִנָּה בַדֶּרֶךְ כחו [כֹּחִי] קִצַּר יָמָי׃
102.e: He weakened my strength in the way; He shortened my days.

102.s: אֹמַר אֵלִי אַל־תַּעֲלֵנִי בַּחֲצִי יָמָי בְּדוֹר דּוֹרִים שְׁנוֹתֶיךָ׃
102.e: I say: 'O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days, Thou whose years endure throughout all generations.

102.s: לְפָנִים הָאָרֶץ יָסַדְתָּ וּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ שָׁמָיִם׃
102.e: Of old Thou didst lay the foundation of the earth; And the heavens are the work of Thy hands.

102.s: הֵמָּה יֹאבֵדוּ וְאַתָּה תַעֲמֹד וְכֻלָּם כַּבֶּגֶד יִבְלוּ כַּלְּבוּשׁ תַּחֲלִיפֵם וְיַחֲלֹפוּ׃
102.e: They shall perish, but Thou shalt endure; Yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; As a vesture shalt Thou change them, and they shall pass away;

102.s: וְאַתָּה־הוּא וּשְׁנוֹתֶיךָ לֹא יִתָּמּוּ׃
102.e: But Thou art the selfsame, And Thy years shall have no end.

102.s: בְּנֵי־עֲבָדֶיךָ יִשְׁכּוֹנוּ וְזַרְעָם לְפָנֶיךָ יִכּוֹן׃
102.e: The children of Thy servants shall dwell securely, And their seed shall be established before Thee.'

103.s: לְדָוִד בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה וְכָל־קְרָבַי אֶת־שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ׃
103.e: [A Psalm] of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; And all that is within me, bless His holy name.

103.s: בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה וְאַל־תִּשְׁכְּחִי כָּל־גְּמוּלָיו׃
103.e: Bless the LORD, O my soul, And forget not all His benefits;

103.s: הַסֹּלֵחַ לְכָל־עֲוֺנֵכִי הָרֹפֵא לְכָל־תַּחֲלֻאָיְכִי׃
103.e: Who forgiveth all thine iniquity; Who healeth all Thy diseases;

103.s: הַגּוֹאֵל מִשַּׁחַת חַיָּיְכִי הַמְעַטְּרֵכִי חֶסֶד וְרַחֲמִים׃
103.e: Who redeemeth Thy life from the pit; Who encompasseth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

103.s: הַמַּשְׂבִּיַע בַּטּוֹב עֶדְיֵךְ תִּתְחַדֵּשׁ כַּנֶּשֶׁר נְעוּרָיְכִי׃
103.e: Who satisfieth thine old age with good things; So that Thy youth is renewed like the eagle.

103.s: עֹשֵׂה צְדָקוֹת יְהוָה וּמִשְׁפָּטִים לְכָל־עֲשׁוּקִים׃
103.e: The LORD executeth righteousness, And acts of justice for all that are oppressed.

103.s: יוֹדִיעַ דְּרָכָיו לְמֹשֶׁה לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עֲלִילוֹתָיו׃
103.e: He made known His ways unto Moses, His doings unto the children of Israel.

103.s: רַחוּם וְחַנּוּן יְהוָה אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וְרַב־חָסֶד׃
103.e: The LORD is full of compassion and gracious, Slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

103.s: לֹא־לָנֶצַח יָרִיב וְלֹא לְעוֹלָם יִטּוֹר׃
103.e: He will not always contend; Neither will He keep His anger for ever.

103.s: לֹא כַחֲטָאֵינוּ עָשָׂה לָנוּ וְלֹא כַעֲוֺנֹתֵינוּ גָּמַל עָלֵינוּ׃
103.e: He hath not dealt with us after our sins, Nor requited us according to our iniquities.

103.s: כִּי כִגְבֹהַּ שָׁמַיִם עַל־הָאָרֶץ גָּבַר חַסְדּוֹ עַל־יְרֵאָיו׃
103.e: For as the heaven is high above the earth, So great is His mercy toward them that fear Him.

103.s: כִּרְחֹק מִזְרָח מִמַּעֲרָב הִרְחִיק מִמֶּנּוּ אֶת־פְּשָׁעֵינוּ׃
103.e: As far as the east is from the west, So far hath He removed our transgressions from us.

103.s: כְּרַחֵם אָב עַל־בָּנִים רִחַם יְהוָה עַל־יְרֵאָיו׃
103.e: Like as a father hath compassion upon his children, So hath the LORD compassion upon them that fear Him. .

103.s: כִּי־הוּא יָדַע יִצְרֵנוּ זָכוּר כִּי־עָפָר אֲנָחְנוּ׃
103.e: For He knoweth our frame; He remembereth that we are dust.

103.s: אֱנוֹשׁ כֶּחָצִיר יָמָיו כְּצִיץ הַשָּׂדֶה כֵּן יָצִיץ׃
103.e: As for man, his days are as grass; As a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

103.s: כִּי רוּחַ עָבְרָה־בּוֹ וְאֵינֶנּוּ וְלֹא־יַכִּירֶנּוּ עוֹד מְקוֹמוֹ׃
103.e: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; And the place thereof knoweth it no more.

103.s: וְחֶסֶד יְהוָה מֵעוֹלָם וְעַד־עוֹלָם עַל־יְרֵאָיו וְצִדְקָתוֹ לִבְנֵי בָנִים׃
103.e: But the mercy of the LORD is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear Him, And His righteousness unto children's children;

103.s: לְשֹׁמְרֵי בְרִיתוֹ וּלְזֹכְרֵי פִקֻּדָיו לַעֲשׂוֹתָם׃
103.e: To such as keep His covenant, And to those that remember His precepts to do them.

103.s: יְהוָה בַּשָּׁמַיִם הֵכִין כִּסְאוֹ וּמַלְכוּתוֹ בַּכֹּל מָשָׁלָה׃
103.e: The LORD hath established His throne in the heavens; And His kingdom ruleth over all.

103.s: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה מַלְאָכָיו גִּבֹּרֵי כֹחַ עֹשֵׂי דְבָרוֹ לִשְׁמֹעַ בְּקוֹל דְּבָרוֹ׃
103.e: Bless the LORD, ye angels of His, Ye mighty in strength, that fulfil His word, Hearkening unto the voice of His word.

103.s: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה כָּל־צְבָאָיו מְשָׁרְתָיו עֹשֵׂי רְצוֹנוֹ׃
103.e: Bless the LORD, all ye His hosts; Ye ministers of His, that do His pleasure.

103.s: בָּרֲכוּ יְהוָה כָּל־מַעֲשָׂיו בְּכָל־מְקֹמוֹת מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה׃
103.e: Bless the LORD, all ye His works, In all places of His dominion; Bless the LORD, O my soul.

104.s: בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי גָּדַלְתָּ מְּאֹד הוֹד וְהָדָר לָבָשְׁתָּ׃
104.e: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, Thou art very great; Thou art clothed with glory and majesty.

104.s: עֹטֶה־אוֹר כַּשַּׂלְמָה נוֹטֶה שָׁמַיִם כַּיְרִיעָה׃
104.e: Who coverest Thyself with light as with a garment, who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain;

104.s: הַמְקָרֶה בַמַּיִם עֲ‍לִיּוֹתָיו הַשָּׂם־עָבִים רְכוּבוֹ הַמְהַלֵּךְ עַל־כַּנְפֵי־רוּחַ׃
104.e: Who layest the beams of Thine upper chambers in the waters, who makest the clouds Thy chariot, who walkest upon the wings of the wind;

104.s: עֹשֶׂה מַלְאָכָיו רוּחוֹת מְשָׁרְתָיו אֵשׁ לֹהֵט׃
104.e: Who makest winds Thy messengers, the flaming fire Thy ministers.

104.s: יָסַד־אֶרֶץ עַל־מְכוֹנֶיהָ בַּל־תִּמּוֹט עוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
104.e: Who didst establish the earth upon its foundations, that it should not be moved for ever and ever;

104.s: תְּהוֹם כַּלְּבוּשׁ כִּסִּיתוֹ עַל־הָרִים יַעַמְדוּ־מָיִם׃
104.e: Thou didst cover it with the deep as with a vesture; the waters stood above the mountains.

104.s: מִן־גַּעֲרָתְךָ יְנוּסוּן מִן־קוֹל רַעַמְךָ יֵחָפֵזוּן׃
104.e: At Thy rebuke they fled, at the voice of Thy thunder they hasted away—

104.s: יַעֲלוּ הָרִים יֵרְדוּ בְקָעוֹת אֶל־מְקוֹם זֶה יָסַדְתָּ לָהֶם׃
104.e: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down— Unto the place which Thou hadst founded for them;

104.s: גְּבוּל־שַׂמְתָּ בַּל־יַעֲבֹרוּן בַּל־יְשׁוּבוּן לְכַסּוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃
104.e: Thou didst set a bound which they should not pass over, That they might not return to cover the earth.

104.s: הַמְשַׁלֵּחַ מַעְיָנִים בַּנְּחָלִים בֵּין הָרִים יְהַלֵּכוּן׃
104.e: Who sendest forth springs into the valleys; They run between the mountains;

104.s: יַשְׁקוּ כָּל־חַיְתוֹ שָׂדָי יִשְׁבְּרוּ פְרָאִים צְמָאָם׃
104.e: They give drink to every beast of the field, The wild asses quench their thirst. .

104.s: עֲלֵיהֶם עוֹף־הַשָּׁמַיִם יִשְׁכּוֹן מִבֵּין עֳפָאיִם יִתְּנוּ־קוֹל׃
104.e: Beside them dwell the fowl of the heaven, From among the branches they sing.

104.s: מַשְׁקֶה הָרִים מֵעֲלִיּוֹתָיו מִפְּרִי מַעֲשֶׂיךָ תִּשְׂבַּע הָאָרֶץ׃
104.e: Who waterest the mountains from Thine upper chambers; The earth is full of the fruit of Thy works.

104.s: מַצְמִיחַ חָצִיר לַבְּהֵמָה וְעֵשֶׂב לַעֲבֹדַת הָאָדָם לְהוֹצִיא לֶחֶם מִן־הָאָרֶץ׃
104.e: Who causeth the grass to spring up for the cattle, And herb for the service of man; To bring forth bread out of the earth,

104.s: וְיַיִן יְשַׂמַּח לְבַב־אֱנוֹשׁ לְהַצְהִיל פָּנִים מִשָּׁמֶן וְלֶחֶם לְבַב־אֱנוֹשׁ יִסְעָד׃
104.e: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, Making the face brighter than oil, And bread that stayeth man's heart.

104.s: יִשְׂבְּעוּ עֲצֵי יְהוָה אַרְזֵי לְבָנוֹן אֲשֶׁר נָטָע׃
104.e: The trees of the LORD have their fill, The cedars of Lebanon, which He hath planted;

104.s: אֲשֶׁר־שָׁם צִפֳּרִים יְקַנֵּנוּ חֲסִידָה בְּרוֹשִׁים בֵּיתָהּ׃
104.e: Wherein the birds make their nests; As for the stork, the fir-trees are her house.

104.s: הָרִים הַגְּבֹהִים לַיְּעֵלִים סְלָעִים מַחְסֶה לַשְׁפַנִּים׃
104.e: The high mountains are for the wild goats; The rocks are a refuge for the conies.

104.s: עָשָׂה יָרֵחַ לְמוֹעֲדִים שֶׁמֶשׁ יָדַע מְבוֹאוֹ׃
104.e: Who appointedst the moon for seasons; The sun knoweth his going down.

104.s: תָּשֶׁת־חֹשֶׁךְ וִיהִי לָיְלָה בּוֹ־תִרְמֹשׂ כָּל־חַיְתוֹ־יָעַר׃
104.e: Thou makest darkness, and it is night, Wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

104.s: הַכְּפִירִים שֹׁאֲגִים לַטָּרֶף וּלְבַקֵּשׁ מֵאֵל אָכְלָם׃
104.e: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.

104.s: תִּזְרַח הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ יֵאָסֵפוּן וְאֶל־מְעוֹנֹתָם יִרְבָּצוּן׃
104.e: The sun ariseth, they slink away, And couch in their dens.

104.s: יֵצֵא אָדָם לְפָעֳלוֹ וְלַעֲבֹדָתוֹ עֲדֵי־עָרֶב׃
104.e: Man goeth forth unto his work And to his labour until the evening.

104.s: מָה־רַבּוּ מַעֲשֶׂיךָ יְהוָה כֻּלָּם בְּחָכְמָה עָשִׂיתָ מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ קִנְיָנֶךָ׃
104.e: How manifold are Thy works, O LORD! In wisdom hast Thou made them all; The earth is full of Thy creatures.

104.s: זֶה הַיָּם גָּדוֹל וּרְחַב יָדָיִם שָׁם־רֶמֶשׂ וְאֵין מִסְפָּר חַיּוֹת קְטַנּוֹת עִם־גְּדֹלוֹת׃
104.e: Yonder sea, great and wide, Therein are creeping things innumerable, Living creatures, both small and great.

104.s: שָׁם אֳנִיּוֹת יְהַלֵּכוּן לִוְיָתָן זֶה־יָצַרְתָּ לְשַׂחֶק־בּוֹ׃
104.e: There go the ships; There is leviathan, whom Thou hast formed to sport therein.

104.s: כֻּלָּם אֵלֶיךָ יְשַׂבֵּרוּן לָתֵת אָכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ׃
104.e: All of them wait for Thee, That Thou mayest give them their food in due season.

104.s: תִּתֵּן לָהֶם יִלְקֹטוּן תִּפְתַּח יָדְךָ יִשְׂבְּעוּן טוֹב׃
104.e: Thou givest it unto them, they gather it; Thou openest Thy hand, they are satisfied with good.

104.s: תַּסְתִּיר פָּנֶיךָ יִבָּהֵלוּן תֹּסֵף רוּחָם יִגְוָעוּן וְאֶל־עֲפָרָם יְשׁוּבוּן׃
104.e: Thou hidest Thy face, they vanish; Thou withdrawest their breath, they perish, And return to their dust.

104.s: תְּשַׁלַּח רוּחֲךָ יִבָּרֵאוּן וּתְחַדֵּשׁ פְּנֵי אֲדָמָה׃
104.e: Thou sendest forth Thy spirit, they are created; and Thou renewest the face of the earth.

104.s: יְהִי כְבוֹד יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם יִשְׂמַח יְהוָה בְּמַעֲשָׂיו׃
104.e: May the glory of the LORD endure for ever; let the LORD rejoice in His works!

104.s: הַמַּבִּיט לָאָרֶץ וַתִּרְעָד יִגַּע בֶּהָרִים וְיֶעֱשָׁנוּ׃
104.e: Who looketh on the earth, and it trembleth; He toucheth the mountains, and they smoke.

104.s: אָשִׁירָה לַיהוָה בְּחַיָּי אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהַי בְּעוֹדִי׃
104.e: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live; I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

104.s: יֶעֱרַב עָלָיו שִׂיחִי אָנֹכִי אֶשְׂמַח בַּיהוָה׃
104.e: Let my musing be sweet unto Him; as for me, I will rejoice in the LORD.

104.s: יִתַּמּוּ חַטָּאִים מִן־הָאָרֶץ וּרְשָׁעִים עוֹד אֵינָם בָּרֲכִי נַפְשִׁי אֶת־יְהוָה הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
104.e: Let sinners cease out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah.

105.s: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה קִרְאוּ בִּשְׁמוֹ הוֹדִיעוּ בָעַמִּים עֲלִילוֹתָיו׃
105.e: O give thanks unto the LORD, call upon His name; Make known His doings among the peoples.

105.s: שִׁירוּ־לוֹ זַמְּרוּ־לוֹ שִׂיחוּ בְּכָל־נִפְלְאוֹתָיו׃
105.e: Sing unto Him, sing praises unto Him; Speak ye of all His marvellous works.

105.s: הִתְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ יִשְׂמַח לֵב מְבַקְשֵׁי יְהוָה׃
105.e: Glory ye in His holy name; Let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.

105.s: דִּרְשׁוּ יְהוָה וְעֻזּוֹ בַּקְּשׁוּ פָנָיו תָּמִיד׃
105.e: Seek ye the LORD and His strength; Seek His face continually.

105.s: זִכְרוּ נִפְלְאוֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂה מֹפְתָיו וּמִשְׁפְּטֵי־פִיו׃
105.e: Remember His marvellous works that He hath done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth;

105.s: זֶרַע אַבְרָהָם עַבְדּוֹ בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב בְּחִירָיו׃
105.e: O ye seed of Abraham His servant, Ye children of Jacob, His chosen ones.

105.s: הוּא יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּכָל־הָאָרֶץ מִשְׁפָּטָיו׃
105.e: He is the LORD our God; His judgments are in all the earth.

105.s: זָכַר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ דָּבָר צִוָּה לְאֶלֶף דּוֹר׃
105.e: He hath remembered His covenant for ever, The word which He commanded to a thousand generations;

105.s: אֲשֶׁר כָּרַת אֶת־אַבְרָהָם וּשְׁבוּעָתוֹ לְיִשְׂחָק׃
105.e: [The covenant] which He made with Abraham, And His oath unto Isaac;

105.s: וַיַּעֲמִידֶהָ לְיַעֲקֹב לְחֹק לְיִשְׂרָאֵל בְּרִית עוֹלָם׃
105.e: And He established it unto Jacob for a statute, To Israel for an everlasting covenant;

105.s: לֵאמֹר לְךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת־אֶרֶץ־כְּנָעַן חֶבֶל נַחֲלַתְכֶם׃
105.e: Saying: 'Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance.'

105.s: בִּהְיוֹתָם מְתֵי מִסְפָּר כִּמְעַט וְגָרִים בָּהּ׃
105.e: When they were but a few men in number. Yea, very few, and sojourners in it,

105.s: וַיִּתְהַלְּכוּ מִגּוֹי אֶל־גּוֹי מִמַּמְלָכָה אֶל־עַם אַחֵר׃
105.e: And when they went about from nation to nation, From one kingdom to another people,

105.s: לֹא־הִנִּיחַ אָדָם לְעָשְׁקָם וַיּוֹכַח עֲלֵיהֶם מְלָכִים׃
105.e: He suffered no man to do them wrong, Yea, for their sake He reproved kings:

105.s: אַל־תִּגְּעוּ בִמְשִׁיחָי וְלִנְבִיאַי אַל־תָּרֵעוּ׃
105.e: 'Touch not Mine anointed ones, And do My prophets no harm.'

105.s: וַיִּקְרָא רָעָב עַל־הָאָרֶץ כָּל־מַטֵּה־לֶחֶם שָׁבָר׃
105.e: And He called a famine upon the land; He broke the whole staff of bread.

105.s: שָׁלַח לִפְנֵיהֶם אִישׁ לְעֶבֶד נִמְכַּר יוֹסֵף׃
105.e: He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a servant;

105.s: עִנּוּ בַכֶּבֶל רגליו [רַגְלוֹ] בַּרְזֶל בָּאָה נַפְשׁוֹ׃
105.e: His feet they hurt with fetters, His person was laid in iron;

105.s: עַד־עֵת בֹּא־דְבָרוֹ אִמְרַת יְהוָה צְרָפָתְהוּ׃
105.e: Until the time that his word came to pass, The word of the LORD tested him.

105.s: שָׁלַח מֶלֶךְ וַיַּתִּירֵהוּ מֹשֵׁל עַמִּים וַיְפַתְּחֵהוּ׃
105.e: The king sent and loosed him; Even the ruler of the peoples, and set him free.

105.s: שָׂמוֹ אָדוֹן לְבֵיתוֹ וּמֹשֵׁל בְּכָל־קִנְיָנוֹ׃
105.e: He made him lord of his house, And ruler of all his possessions;

105.s: לֶאְסֹר שָׂרָיו בְּנַפְשׁוֹ וּזְקֵנָיו יְחַכֵּם׃
105.e: To bind his princes at his pleasure, And teach his elders wisdom.

105.s: וַיָּבֹא יִשְׂרָאֵל מִצְרָיִם וְיַעֲקֹב גָּר בְּאֶרֶץ־חָם׃
105.e: Israel also came into Egypt; And Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

105.s: וַיֶּפֶר אֶת־עַמּוֹ מְאֹד וַיַּעֲצִמֵהוּ מִצָּרָיו׃
105.e: And He increased His people greatly, And made them too mighty for their adversaries.

105.s: הָפַךְ לִבָּם לִשְׂנֹא עַמּוֹ לְהִתְנַכֵּל בַּעֲבָדָיו׃
105.e: He turned their heart to hate His people, To deal craftily with His servants.

105.s: שָׁלַח מֹשֶׁה עַבְדּוֹ אַהֲרֹן אֲשֶׁר בָּחַר־בּוֹ׃
105.e: He sent Moses His servant, And Aaron whom He had chosen.

105.s: שָׂמוּ־בָם דִּבְרֵי אֹתוֹתָיו וּמֹפְתִים בְּאֶרֶץ חָם׃
105.e: They wrought among them His manifold signs, And wonders in the land of Ham.

105.s: שָׁלַח חֹשֶׁךְ וַיַּחְשִׁךְ וְלֹא־מָרוּ אֶת־דברוו [דְּבָרוֹ׃]
105.e: He sent darkness, and it was dark; And they rebelled not against His word.

105.s: הָפַךְ אֶת־מֵימֵיהֶם לְדָם וַיָּמֶת אֶת־דְּגָתָם׃
105.e: He turned their waters into blood, And slew their fish.

105.s: שָׁרַץ אַרְצָם צְפַרְדְּעִים בְּחַדְרֵי מַלְכֵיהֶם׃
105.e: Their land swarmed with frogs, In the chambers of their kings.

105.s: אָמַר וַיָּבֹא עָרֹב כִּנִּים בְּכָל־גְּבוּלָם׃
105.e: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, And gnats in all their borders.

105.s: נָתַן גִּשְׁמֵיהֶם בָּרָד אֵשׁ לֶהָבוֹת בְּאַרְצָם׃
105.e: He gave them hail for rain, And flaming fire in their land.

105.s: וַיַּךְ גַּפְנָם וּתְאֵנָתָם וַיְשַׁבֵּר עֵץ גְּבוּלָם׃
105.e: He smote their vines also and their fig-trees; And broke the trees of their borders.

105.s: אָמַר וַיָּבֹא אַרְבֶּה וְיֶלֶק וְאֵין מִסְפָּר׃
105.e: He spoke, and the locust came, And the canker-worm without number,

105.s: וַיֹּאכַל כָּל־עֵשֶׂב בְּאַרְצָם וַיֹּאכַל פְּרִי אַדְמָתָם׃
105.e: And did eat up every herb in their land, And did eat up the fruit of their ground.

105.s: וַיַּךְ כָּל־בְּכוֹר בְּאַרְצָם רֵאשִׁית לְכָל־אוֹנָם׃
105.e: He smote also all the first-born in their land, The first-fruits of all their strength.

105.s: וַיּוֹצִיאֵם בְּכֶסֶף וְזָהָב וְאֵין בִּשְׁבָטָיו כּוֹשֵׁל׃
105.e: And He brought them forth with silver and gold; And there was none that stumbled among His tribes.

105.s: שָׂמַח מִצְרַיִם בְּצֵאתָם כִּי־נָפַל פַּחְדָּם עֲלֵיהֶם׃
105.e: Egypt was glad when they departed; For the fear of them had fallen upon them.

105.s: פָּרַשׂ עָנָן לְמָסָךְ וְאֵשׁ לְהָאִיר לָיְלָה׃
105.e: He spread a cloud for a screen; And fire to give light in the night.

105.s: שָׁאַל וַיָּבֵא שְׂלָו וְלֶחֶם שָׁמַיִם יַשְׂבִּיעֵם׃
105.e: They asked, and He brought quails, And gave them in plenty the bread of heaven.

105.s: פָּתַח צוּר וַיָּזוּבוּ מָיִם הָלְכוּ בַּצִּיּוֹת נָהָר׃
105.e: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out; They ran, a river in the dry places.

105.s: כִּי־זָכַר אֶת־דְּבַר קָדְשׁוֹ אֶת־אַבְרָהָם עַבְדּוֹ׃
105.e: For He remembered His holy word Unto Abraham His servant;

105.s: וַיּוֹצִא עַמּוֹ בְשָׂשׂוֹן בְּרִנָּה אֶת־בְּחִירָיו׃
105.e: And He brought forth His people with joy, His chosen ones with singing.

105.s: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם אַרְצוֹת גּוֹיִם וַעֲמַל לְאֻמִּים יִירָשׁוּ׃
105.e: And He gave them the lands of the nations, And they took the labour of the peoples in possession;

105.s: בַּעֲבוּר יִשְׁמְרוּ חֻקָּיו וְתוֹרֹתָיו יִנְצֹרוּ הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
105.e: That they might keep His statutes, And observe His laws. Hallelujah.

106.s: הַלְלוּיָהּ הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
106.e: Hallelujah. O give thanks unto the LORD; for He is good; for His mercy endureth for ever.

106.s: מִי יְמַלֵּל גְּבוּרוֹת יְהוָה יַשְׁמִיעַ כָּל־תְּהִלָּתוֹ׃
106.e: Who can express the mighty acts of the LORD, or make all His praise to be heard?

106.s: אַשְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵי מִשְׁפָּט עֹשֵׂה צְדָקָה בְכָל־עֵת׃
106.e: Happy are they that keep justice, that do righteousness at all times.

106.s: זָכְרֵנִי יְהוָה בִּרְצוֹן עַמֶּךָ פָּקְדֵנִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶךָ׃
106.e: Remember me, O LORD, when Thou favourest Thy people; O think of me at Thy salvation;

106.s: לִרְאוֹת בְּטוֹבַת בְּחִירֶיךָ לִשְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַת גּוֹיֶךָ לְהִתְהַלֵּל עִם־נַחֲלָתֶךָ׃
106.e: That I may behold the prosperity of Thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of Thy nation, that I may glory with Thine inheritance.

106.s: חָטָאנוּ עִם־אֲבוֹתֵינוּ הֶעֱוִינוּ הִרְשָׁעְנוּ׃
106.e: We have sinned with our fathers, we have done iniquitously, we have dealt wickedly.

106.s: אֲבוֹתֵינוּ בְמִצְרַיִם לֹא־הִשְׂכִּילוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ לֹא זָכְרוּ אֶת־רֹב חֲסָדֶיךָ וַיַּמְרוּ עַל־יָם בְּיַם־סוּף׃
106.e: Our fathers in Egypt gave no heed unto Thy wonders; they remembered not the multitude of Thy mercies; but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

106.s: וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם לְמַעַן שְׁמוֹ לְהוֹדִיעַ אֶת־גְּבוּרָתוֹ׃
106.e: Nevertheless He saved them for His name's sake, that He might make His mighty power to be known.

106.s: וַיִּגְעַר בְּיַם־סוּף וַיֶּחֱרָב וַיּוֹלִיכֵם בַּתְּהֹמוֹת כַּמִּדְבָּר׃
106.e: And He rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up; and He led them through the depths, as through a wilderness.

106.s: וַיּוֹשִׁיעֵם מִיַּד שׂוֹנֵא וַיִּגְאָלֵם מִיַּד אוֹיֵב׃
106.e: And He saved them from the hand of him that hated them, And redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

106.s: וַיְכַסּוּ־מַיִם צָרֵיהֶם אֶחָד מֵהֶם לֹא נוֹתָר׃
106.e: And the waters covered their adversaries; There was not one of them left.

106.s: וַיַּאֲמִינוּ בִדְבָרָיו יָשִׁירוּ תְּהִלָּתוֹ׃
106.e: Then believed they His words; They sang His praise.

106.s: מִהֲרוּ שָׁכְחוּ מַעֲשָׂיו לֹא־חִכּוּ לַעֲצָתוֹ׃
106.e: They soon forgot His works; They waited not for His counsel;

106.s: וַיִּתְאַוּוּ תַאֲוָה בַּמִּדְבָּר וַיְנַסּוּ־אֵל בִּישִׁימוֹן׃
106.e: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, And tried God in the desert.

106.s: וַיִּתֵּן לָהֶם שֶׁאֱלָתָם וַיְשַׁלַּח רָזוֹן בְּנַפְשָׁם׃
106.e: And He gave them their request; But sent leanness into their soul.

106.s: וַיְקַנְאוּ לְמֹשֶׁה בַּמַּחֲנֶה לְאַהֲרֹן קְדוֹשׁ יְהוָה׃
106.e: They were jealous also of Moses in the camp, And of Aaron the holy one of the LORD.

106.s: תִּפְתַּח־אֶרֶץ וַתִּבְלַע דָּתָן וַתְּכַס עַל־עֲדַת אֲבִירָם׃
106.e: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, And covered the company of Abiram.

106.s: וַתִּבְעַר־אֵשׁ בַּעֲדָתָם לֶהָבָה תְּלַהֵט רְשָׁעִים׃
106.e: And a fire was kindled in their company; The flame burned up the wicked.

106.s: יַעֲשׂוּ־עֵגֶל בְּחֹרֵב וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ לְמַסֵּכָה׃
106.e: They made a calf in Horeb, And worshipped a molten image.

106.s: וַיָּמִירוּ אֶת־כְּבוֹדָם בְּתַבְנִית שׁוֹר אֹכֵל עֵשֶׂב׃
106.e: Thus they exchanged their glory For the likeness of an ox that eateth grass.

106.s: שָׁכְחוּ אֵל מוֹשִׁיעָם עֹשֶׂה גְדֹלוֹת בְּמִצְרָיִם׃
106.e: They forgot God their saviour, Who had done great things in Egypt;

106.s: נִפְלָאוֹת בְּאֶרֶץ חָם נוֹרָאוֹת עַל־יַם־סוּף׃
106.e: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, Terrible things by the Red Sea.

106.s: וַיֹּאמֶר לְהַשְׁמִידָם לוּלֵי מֹשֶׁה בְחִירוֹ עָמַד בַּפֶּרֶץ לְפָנָיו לְהָשִׁיב חֲמָתוֹ מֵהַשְׁחִית׃
106.e: Therefore He said that He would destroy them, Had not Moses His chosen stood before Him in the breach, To turn back His wrath, lest He should destroy them.

106.s: וַיִּמְאֲסוּ בְּאֶרֶץ חֶמְדָּה לֹא־הֶאֱמִינוּ לִדְבָרוֹ׃
106.e: Moreover, they scorned the desirable land, They believed not His word;

106.s: וַיֵּרָגְנוּ בְאָהֳלֵיהֶם לֹא שָׁמְעוּ בְּקוֹל יְהוָה׃
106.e: And they murmured in their tents, They hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.

106.s: וַיִּשָּׂא יָדוֹ לָהֶם לְהַפִּיל אוֹתָם בַּמִּדְבָּר׃
106.e: Therefore He swore concerning them, That He would overthrow them in the wilderness;

106.s: וּלְהַפִּיל זַרְעָם בַּגּוֹיִם וּלְזָרוֹתָם בָּאֲרָצוֹת׃
106.e: And that He would cast out their seed among the nations, And scatter them in the lands.

106.s: וַיִּצָּמְדוּ לְבַעַל פְּעוֹר וַיֹּאכְלוּ זִבְחֵי מֵתִים׃
106.e: They joined themselves also unto Baal of Peor, And ate the sacrifices of the dead.

106.s: וַיַּכְעִיסוּ בְּמַעַלְלֵיהֶם וַתִּפְרָץ־בָּם מַגֵּפָה׃
106.e: Thus they provoked Him with their doings, And the plague broke in upon them.

106.s: וַיַּעֲמֹד פִּינְחָס וַיְפַלֵּל וַתֵּעָצַר הַמַּגֵּפָה׃
106.e: Then stood up Phinehas, and wrought judgment, And so the plague was stayed.

106.s: וַתֵּחָשֶׁב לוֹ לִצְדָקָה לְדֹר וָדֹר עַד־עוֹלָם׃
106.e: And that was counted unto him for righteousness, Unto all generations for ever.

106.s: וַיַּקְצִיפוּ עַל־מֵי מְרִיבָה וַיֵּרַע לְמֹשֶׁה בַּעֲבוּרָם׃
106.e: They angered Him also at the waters of Meribah, And it went ill with Moses because of them;

106.s: כִּי־הִמְרוּ אֶת־רוּחוֹ וַיְבַטֵּא בִּשְׂפָתָיו׃
106.e: For they embittered his spirit, And he spoke rashly with his lips.

106.s: לֹא־הִשְׁמִידוּ אֶת־הָעַמִּים אֲשֶׁר אָמַר יְהוָה לָהֶם׃
106.e: They did not destroy the peoples, As the LORD commanded them;

106.s: וַיִּתְעָרְבוּ בַגּוֹיִם וַיִּלְמְדוּ מַעֲשֵׂיהֶם׃
106.e: But mingled themselves with the nations, And learned their works;

106.s: וַיַּעַבְדוּ אֶת־עֲצַבֵּיהֶם וַיִּהְיוּ לָהֶם לְמוֹקֵשׁ׃
106.e: And they served their idols, Which became a snare unto them;

106.s: וַיִּזְבְּחוּ אֶת־בְּנֵיהֶם וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶם לַשֵּׁדִים׃
106.e: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto demons,

106.s: וַיִּשְׁפְּכוּ דָם נָקִי דַּם־בְּנֵיהֶם וּבְנוֹתֵיהֶם אֲשֶׁר זִבְּחוּ לַעֲצַבֵּי כְנָעַן וַתֶּחֱנַף הָאָרֶץ בַּדָּמִים׃
106.e: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, Whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan; And the land was polluted with blood.

106.s: וַיִּטְמְאוּ בְמַעֲשֵׂיהֶם וַיִּזְנוּ בְּמַעַלְלֵיהֶם׃
106.e: Thus were they defiled with their works, And went astray in their doings.

106.s: וַיִּחַר־אַף יְהוָה בְּעַמּוֹ וַיְתָעֵב אֶת־נַחֲלָתוֹ׃
106.e: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against His people, And He abhorred His inheritance.

106.s: וַיִּתְּנֵם בְּיַד־גּוֹיִם וַיִּמְשְׁלוּ בָהֶם שֹׂנְאֵיהֶם׃
106.e: And He gave them into the hand of the nations; And they that hated them ruled over them.

106.s: וַיִּלְחָצוּם אוֹיְבֵיהֶם וַיִּכָּנְעוּ תַּחַת יָדָם׃
106.e: Their enemies also oppressed them, And they were subdued under their hand.

106.s: פְּעָמִים רַבּוֹת יַצִּילֵם וְהֵמָּה יַמְרוּ בַעֲצָתָם וַיָּמֹכּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָם׃
106.e: Many times did He deliver them; But they were rebellious in their counsel, And sank low through their iniquity.

106.s: וַיַּרְא בַּצַּר לָהֶם בְּשָׁמְעוֹ אֶת־רִנָּתָם׃
106.e: Nevertheless He looked upon their distress, When He heard their cry;

106.s: וַיִּזְכֹּר לָהֶם בְּרִיתוֹ וַיִּנָּחֵם כְּרֹב חסדו [חֲסָדָיו׃]
106.e: And He remembered for them His covenant, And repented according to the multitude of His mercies.

106.s: וַיִּתֵּן אוֹתָם לְרַחֲמִים לִפְנֵי כָּל־שׁוֹבֵיהֶם׃
106.e: He made them also to be pitied Of all those that carried them captive.

106.s: הוֹשִׁיעֵנוּ יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ וְקַבְּצֵנוּ מִן־הַגּוֹיִם לְהֹדוֹת לְשֵׁם קָדְשֶׁךָ לְהִשְׁתַּבֵּחַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶךָ׃
106.e: Save us, O LORD our God, And gather us from among the nations, That we may give thanks unto Thy holy name, That we may triumph in Thy praise.

106.s: בָּרוּךְ־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל מִן־הָעוֹלָם וְעַד הָעוֹלָם וְאָמַר כָּל־הָעָם אָמֵן הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
106.e: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting, and let all the people say: 'Amen.' Hallelujah.

107.s: הֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
107.e: 'O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever.'

107.s: יֹאמְרוּ גְּאוּלֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר גְּאָלָם מִיַּד־צָר׃
107.e: So let the redeemed of the LORD say, Whom He hath redeemed from the hand of the adversary;

107.s: וּמֵאֲרָצוֹת קִבְּצָם מִמִּזְרָח וּמִמַּעֲרָב מִצָּפוֹן וּמִיָּם׃
107.e: And gathered them out of the lands, From the east and from the west, From the north and from the sea.

107.s: תָּעוּ בַמִּדְבָּר בִּישִׁימוֹן דָּרֶךְ עִיר מוֹשָׁב לֹא מָצָאוּ׃
107.e: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way; They found no city of habitation.

107.s: רְעֵבִים גַּם־צְמֵאִים נַפְשָׁם בָּהֶם תִּתְעַטָּף׃
107.e: Hungry and thirsty, Their soul fainted in them.

107.s: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצוּקוֹתֵיהֶם יַצִּילֵם׃
107.e: Then they cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He delivered them out of their distresses.

107.s: וַיַּדְרִיכֵם בְּדֶרֶךְ יְשָׁרָה לָלֶכֶת אֶל־עִיר מוֹשָׁב׃
107.e: And He led them by a straight way, That they might go to a city of habitation.

107.s: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
107.e: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!

107.s: כִּי־הִשְׂבִּיעַ נֶפֶשׁ שֹׁקֵקָה וְנֶפֶשׁ רְעֵבָה מִלֵּא־טוֹב׃
107.e: For He hath satisfied the longing soul, And the hungry soul He hath filled with good.

107.s: יֹשְׁבֵי חֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת אֲסִירֵי עֳנִי וּבַרְזֶל׃
107.e: Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, Being bound in affliction and iron—

107.s: כִּי־הִמְרוּ אִמְרֵי־אֵל וַעֲצַת עֶלְיוֹן נָאָצוּ׃
107.e: Because they rebelled against the words of God, And contemned the counsel of the Most High.

107.s: וַיַּכְנַע בֶּעָמָל לִבָּם כָּשְׁלוּ וְאֵין עֹזֵר׃
107.e: Therefore He humbled their heart with travail, They stumbled, and there was none to help—

107.s: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצֻקוֹתֵיהֶם יוֹשִׁיעֵם׃
107.e: They cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He saved them out of their distresses.

107.s: יוֹצִיאֵם מֵחֹשֶׁךְ וְצַלְמָוֶת וּמוֹסְרוֹתֵיהֶם יְנַתֵּק׃
107.e: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, And broke their bands in sunder. .

107.s: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
107.e: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!

107.s: כִּי־שִׁבַּר דַּלְתוֹת נְחֹשֶׁת וּבְרִיחֵי בַרְזֶל גִּדֵּעַ׃
107.e: For He hath broken the gates of brass, And cut the bars of iron in sunder.

107.s: אֱוִלִים מִדֶּרֶךְ פִּשְׁעָם וּמֵעֲוֺנֹתֵיהֶם יִתְעַנּוּ׃
107.e: Crazed because of the way of their transgression, And afflicted because of their iniquities—

107.s: כָּל־אֹכֶל תְּתַעֵב נַפְשָׁם וַיַּגִּיעוּ עַד־שַׁעֲרֵי מָוֶת׃
107.e: Their soul abhorred all manner of food, And they drew near unto the gates of death—

107.s: וַיִּזְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם מִמְּצֻקוֹתֵיהֶם יוֹשִׁיעֵם׃
107.e: They cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He saved them out of their distresses;

107.s: יִשְׁלַח דְּבָרוֹ וְיִרְפָּאֵם וִימַלֵּט מִשְּׁחִיתוֹתָם׃
107.e: He sent His word, and healed them, And delivered them from their graves.

107.s: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
107.e: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!

107.s: וְיִזְבְּחוּ זִבְחֵי תוֹדָה וִיסַפְּרוּ מַעֲשָׂיו בְּרִנָּה׃
107.e: And let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, And declare His works with singing.

107.s: יוֹרְדֵי הַיָּם בָּאֳנִיּוֹת עֹשֵׂי מְלָאכָה בְּמַיִם רַבִּים׃
107.e: They that go down to the sea in ships, That do business in great waters—

107.s: הֵמָּה רָאוּ מַעֲשֵׂי יְהוָה וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו בִּמְצוּלָה׃
107.e: These saw the works of the LORD, And His wonders in the deep;

107.s: וַיֹּאמֶר וַיַּעֲמֵד רוּחַ סְעָרָה וַתְּרוֹמֵם גַּלָּיו׃
107.e: For He commanded, and raised the stormy wind, Which lifted up the waves thereof;

107.s: יַעֲלוּ שָׁמַיִם יֵרְדוּ תְהוֹמוֹת נַפְשָׁם בְּרָעָה תִתְמוֹגָג׃
107.e: They mounted up to the heaven, they went down to the deeps; Their soul melted away because of trouble;

107.s: יָחוֹגּוּ וְיָנוּעוּ כַּשִּׁכּוֹר וְכָל־חָכְמָתָם תִּתְבַּלָּע׃
107.e: They reeled to and fro, and staggered like a drunken man, And all their wisdom was swallowed up—

107.s: וַיִּצְעֲקוּ אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצַּר לָהֶם וּמִמְּצוּקֹתֵיהֶם יוֹצִיאֵם׃
107.e: They cried unto the LORD in their trouble, And He brought them out of their distresses.

107.s: יָקֵם סְעָרָה לִדְמָמָה וַיֶּחֱשׁוּ גַּלֵּיהֶם׃
107.e: He made the storm a calm, So that the waves thereof were still.

107.s: וַיִּשְׂמְחוּ כִי־יִשְׁתֹּקוּ וַיַּנְחֵם אֶל־מְחוֹז חֶפְצָם׃
107.e: Then were they glad because they were quiet, And He led them unto their desired haven.

107.s: יוֹדוּ לַיהוָה חַסְדּוֹ וְנִפְלְאוֹתָיו לִבְנֵי אָדָם׃
107.e: Let them give thanks unto the LORD for His mercy, And for His wonderful works to the children of men!

107.s: וִירֹמְמוּהוּ בִּקְהַל־עָם וּבְמוֹשַׁב זְקֵנִים יְהַלְלוּהוּ׃
107.e: Let them exalt Him also in the assembly of the people, And praise Him in the seat of the elders.

107.s: יָשֵׂם נְהָרוֹת לְמִדְבָּר וּמֹצָאֵי מַיִם לְצִמָּאוֹן׃
107.e: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, And watersprings into a thirsty ground;

107.s: אֶרֶץ פְּרִי לִמְלֵחָה מֵרָעַת יֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃
107.e: A fruitful land into a salt waste, For the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

107.s: יָשֵׂם מִדְבָּר לַאֲגַם־מַיִם וְאֶרֶץ צִיָּה לְמֹצָאֵי מָיִם׃
107.e: He turneth a wilderness into a pool of water, And a dry land into watersprings.

107.s: וַיּוֹשֶׁב שָׁם רְעֵבִים וַיְכוֹנְנוּ עִיר מוֹשָׁב׃
107.e: And there He maketh the hungry to dwell, And they establish a city of habitation;

107.s: וַיִּזְרְעוּ שָׂדוֹת וַיִּטְּעוּ כְרָמִים וַיַּעֲשׂוּ פְּרִי תְבוּאָה׃
107.e: And sow fields, and plant vineyards, Which yield fruits of increase.

107.s: וַיְבָרֲכֵם וַיִּרְבּוּ מְאֹד וּבְהֶמְתָּם לֹא יַמְעִיט׃
107.e: He blesseth them also, so that they are multiplied greatly, And suffereth not their cattle to decrease.

107.s: וַיִּמְעֲטוּ וַיָּשֹׁחוּ מֵעֹצֶר רָעָה וְיָגוֹן׃
107.e: Again, they are minished and dwindle away Through oppression of evil and sorrow.

107.s: שֹׁפֵךְ בּוּז עַל־נְדִיבִים וַיַּתְעֵם בְּתֹהוּ לֹא־דָרֶךְ׃
107.e: He poureth contempt upon princes, And causeth them to wander in the waste, where there is no way.

107.s: וַיְשַׂגֵּב אֶבְיוֹן מֵעוֹנִי וַיָּשֶׂם כַּצֹּאן מִשְׁפָּחוֹת׃
107.e: Yet setteth He the needy on high from affliction, And maketh his families like a flock.

107.s: יִרְאוּ יְשָׁרִים וְיִשְׂמָחוּ וְכָל־עַוְלָה קָפְצָה פִּיהָ׃
107.e: The upright see it, and are glad; And all iniquity stoppeth her mouth.

107.s: מִי־חָכָם וְיִשְׁמָר־אֵלֶּה וְיִתְבּוֹנְנוּ חַסְדֵי יְהוָה׃
107.e: Whoso is wise, let him observe these things, And let them consider the mercies of the LORD.

108.e: A Song, a Psalm of David.

108.s: נָכוֹן לִבִּי אֱלֹהִים אָשִׁירָה וַאֲזַמְּרָה אַף־כְּבוֹדִי׃
108.e: My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing, yea, I will sing praises, even with my glory.
Awake, psaltery and harp; I will awake the dawn.
I will give thanks unto Thee, O LORD, among the peoples; And I will sing praises unto Thee among the nations.
For Thy mercy is great above the heavens, And Thy truth reacheth unto the skies.

108.s: רוּמָה עַל־שָׁמַיִם אֱלֹהִים וְעַל כָּל־הָאָרֶץ כְּבוֹדֶךָ׃
108.e: Be Thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; And Thy glory be above all the earth.

108.s: לְמַעַן יֵחָלְצוּן יְדִידֶיךָ הוֹשִׁיעָה יְמִינְךָ וַעֲנֵנִי׃
108.e: That Thy beloved may be delivered, Save with Thy right hand, and answer me.

108.s: אֱלֹהִים דִּבֶּר בְּקָדְשׁוֹ אֶעְלֹזָה אֲחַלְּקָה שְׁכֶם וְעֵמֶק סֻכּוֹת אֲמַדֵּד׃
108.e: God spoke in His holiness, that I would exult; That I would divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

108.s: לִי גִלְעָד לִי מְנַשֶּׁה וְאֶפְרַיִם מָעוֹז רֹאשִׁי יְהוּדָה מְחֹקְקִי׃
108.e: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the defence of my head; Judah is my sceptre.

108.s: מוֹאָב סִיר רַחְצִי עַל־אֱדוֹם אַשְׁלִיךְ נַעֲלִי עֲלֵי־פְלֶשֶׁת אֶתְרוֹעָע׃
108.e: Moab is my washpot; Upon Edom do I cast my shoe; Over Philistia do I cry aloud.

108.s: מִי יֹבִלֵנִי עִיר מִבְצָר מִי נָחַנִי עַד־אֱדוֹם׃
108.e: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me unto Edom?
Hast not Thou cast us off, O God? And Thou goest not forth, O God, with our hosts?

108.s: הָבָה־לָּנוּ עֶזְרָת מִצָּר וְשָׁוְא תְּשׁוּעַת אָדָם׃
108.e: Give us help against the adversary; For vain is the help of man.
Through God we shall do valiantly; For He it is that will tread down our adversaries.

109.s: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר אֱלֹהֵי תְהִלָּתִי אַל־תֶּחֱרַשׁ׃
109.e: For the Leader. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, keep not silence;

109.s: כִּי פִי רָשָׁע וּפִי־מִרְמָה עָלַי פָּתָחוּ דִּבְּרוּ אִתִּי לְשׁוֹן שָׁקֶר׃
109.e: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me; They have spoken unto me with a lying tongue.

109.s: וְדִבְרֵי שִׂנְאָה סְבָבוּנִי וַיִּלָּחֲמוּנִי חִנָּם׃
109.e: They compassed me about also with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.

109.s: תַּחַת־אַהֲבָתִי יִשְׂטְנוּנִי וַאֲנִי תְפִלָּה׃
109.e: In return for my love they are my adversaries; But I am all prayer.

109.s: וַיָּשִׂימוּ עָלַי רָעָה תַּחַת טוֹבָה וְשִׂנְאָה תַּחַת אַהֲבָתִי׃
109.e: And they have laid upon me evil for good, And hatred for my love:

109.s: הַפְקֵד עָלָיו רָשָׁע וְשָׂטָן יַעֲמֹד עַל־יְמִינוֹ׃
109.e: ’Set Thou a wicked man over him; And let an adversary stand at his right hand.

109.s: בְּהִשָּׁפְטוֹ יֵצֵא רָשָׁע וּתְפִלָּתוֹ תִּהְיֶה לַחֲטָאָה׃
109.e: When he is judged, let him go forth condemned; And let his prayer be turned into sin.

109.s: יִהְיוּ־יָמָיו מְעַטִּים פְּקֻדָּתוֹ יִקַּח אַחֵר׃
109.e: Let his days be few; Let another take his charge.

109.s: יִהְיוּ־בָנָיו יְתוֹמִים וְאִשְׁתּוֹ אַלְמָנָה׃
109.e: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.

109.s: וְנוֹעַ יָנוּעוּ בָנָיו וְשִׁאֵלוּ וְדָרְשׁוּ מֵחָרְבוֹתֵיהֶם׃
109.e: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg; And let them seek their bread out of their desolate places.

109.s: יְנַקֵּשׁ נוֹשֶׁה לְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וְיָבֹזּוּ זָרִים יְגִיעוֹ׃
109.e: Let the creditor distrain all that he hath; And let strangers make spoil of his labour.

109.s: אַל־יְהִי־לוֹ מֹשֵׁךְ חָסֶד וְאַל־יְהִי חוֹנֵן לִיתוֹמָיו׃
109.e: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him; Neither let there be any to be gracious unto his fatherless children.

109.s: יְהִי־אַחֲרִיתוֹ לְהַכְרִית בְּדוֹר אַחֵר יִמַּח שְׁמָם׃
109.e: Let his posterity be cut off; In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

109.s: יִזָּכֵר עֲוֺן אֲבֹתָיו אֶל־יְהוָה וְחַטַּאת אִמּוֹ אַל־תִּמָּח׃
109.e: Let the iniquity of his fathers be brought to remembrance unto the LORD; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

109.s: יִהְיוּ נֶגֶד־יְהוָה תָּמִיד וְיַכְרֵת מֵאֶרֶץ זִכְרָם׃
109.e: Let them be before the LORD continually, That He may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

109.s: יַעַן אֲשֶׁר לֹא זָכַר עֲשׂוֹת חָסֶד וַיִּרְדֹּף אִישׁ־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן וְנִכְאֵה לֵבָב לְמוֹתֵת׃
109.e: Because that he remembered not to do kindness, But persecuted the poor and needy man, And the broken in heart he was ready to slay.

109.s: וַיֶּאֱהַב קְלָלָה וַתְּבוֹאֵהוּ וְלֹא־חָפֵץ בִּבְרָכָה וַתִּרְחַק מִמֶּנּוּ׃
109.e: Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him; And he delighted not in blessing, and it is far from him.

109.s: וַיִּלְבַּשׁ קְלָלָה כְּמַדּוֹ וַתָּבֹא כַמַּיִם בְּקִרְבּוֹ וְכַשֶּׁמֶן בְּעַצְמוֹתָיו׃
109.e: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his raiment, And it is come into his inward parts like water, And like oil into his bones.

109.s: תְּהִי־לוֹ כְּבֶגֶד יַעְטֶה וּלְמֵזַח תָּמִיד יַחְגְּרֶהָ׃
109.e: Let it be unto him as the garment which he putteth on, And for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.'

109.s: זֹאת פְּעֻלַּת שֹׂטְנַי מֵאֵת יְהוָה וְהַדֹּבְרִים רָע עַל־נַפְשִׁי׃
109.e: This would mine adversaries effect from the LORD, And they that speak evil against my soul.

109.s: וְאַתָּה יְהוִה אֲדֹנָי עֲ‍שֵׂה־אִתִּי לְמַעַן שְׁמֶךָ כִּי־טוֹב חַסְדְּךָ הַצִּילֵנִי׃
109.e: But Thou, O GOD the Lord, deal with me for Thy name's sake; Because Thy mercy is good, deliver Thou me.

109.s: כִּי־עָנִי וְאֶבְיוֹן אָנֹכִי וְלִבִּי חָלַל בְּקִרְבִּי׃
109.e: For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.

109.s: כְּצֵל־כִּנְטוֹתוֹ נֶהֱלָכְתִּי נִנְעַרְתִּי כָּאַרְבֶּה׃
109.e: I am gone like the shadow when it lengtheneth; I am shaken off as the locust.

109.s: בִּרְכַּי כָּשְׁלוּ מִצּוֹם וּבְשָׂרִי כָּחַשׁ מִשָּׁמֶן׃
109.e: My knees totter through fasting; And my flesh is lean, and hath no fatness.

109.s: וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי חֶרְפָּה לָהֶם יִרְאוּנִי יְנִיעוּן רֹאשָׁם׃
109.e: I am become also a taunt unto them; When they see me, they shake their head.

109.s: עָזְרֵנִי יְהוָה אֱלֹהָי הוֹשִׁיעֵנִי כְחַסְדֶּךָ׃
109.e: Help me, O LORD my God; O save me according to Thy mercy;

109.s: וְיֵדְעוּ כִּי־יָדְךָ זֹּאת אַתָּה יְהוָה עֲשִׂיתָהּ׃
109.e: That they may know that this is Thy hand; That Thou, LORD, hast done it.

109.s: יְקַלְלוּ־הֵמָּה וְאַתָּה תְבָרֵךְ קָמוּ וַיֵּבֹשׁוּ וְעַבְדְּךָ יִשְׂמָח׃
109.e: Let them curse, but bless Thou; When they arise, they shall be put to shame, but Thy servant shall rejoice.

109.s: יִלְבְּשׁוּ שׂוֹטְנַי כְּלִמָּה וְיַעֲטוּ כַמְעִיל בָּשְׁתָּם׃
109.e: Mine adversaries shall be clothed with confusion, And shall put on their own shame as a robe.

109.s: אוֹדֶה יְהוָה מְאֹד בְּפִי וּבְתוֹךְ רַבִּים אֲהַלְלֶנּוּ׃
109.e: I will give great thanks unto the LORD with my mouth; Yea, I will praise Him among the multitude;

109.s: כִּי־יַעֲמֹד לִימִין אֶבְיוֹן לְהוֹשִׁיעַ מִשֹּׁפְטֵי נַפְשׁוֹ׃
109.e: Because He standeth at the right hand of the needy, To save him from them that judge his soul.

110.s: לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר נְאֻם יְהוָה לַאדֹנִי שֵׁב לִימִינִי עַד־אָשִׁית אֹיְבֶיךָ הֲדֹם לְרַגְלֶיךָ׃
110.e: A Psalm of David. The LORD saith unto my lord: ‘Sit thou at My right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.'

110.s: מַטֵּה־עֻזְּךָ יִשְׁלַח יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן רְדֵה בְּקֶרֶב אֹיְבֶיךָ׃
110.e: The rod of Thy strength the LORD will send out of Zion: 'Rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.'

110.s: עַמְּךָ נְדָבֹת בְּיוֹם חֵילֶךָ בְּהַדְרֵי־קֹדֶשׁ מֵרֶחֶם מִשְׁחָר לְךָ טַל יַלְדֻתֶיךָ׃
110.e: Thy people offer themselves willingly in the day of thy warfare; in adornments of holiness, from the womb of the dawn, Thine is the dew of thy youth.

110.s: נִשְׁבַּע יְהוָה וְלֹא יִנָּחֵם אַתָּה־כֹהֵן לְעוֹלָם עַל־דִּבְרָתִי מַלְכִּי־צֶדֶק׃
110.e: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent: 'Thou art a priest for ever After the manner of Melchizedek.'
The Lord at thy right hand Doth crush kings in the day of His wrath.

110.s: יָדִין בַּגּוֹיִם מָלֵא גְוִיּוֹת מָחַץ רֹאשׁ עַל־אֶרֶץ רַבָּה׃
110.e: He will judge among the nations; He filleth it with the dead bodies, He crusheth the head over a wide land.

110.s: מִנַּחַל בַּדֶּרֶךְ יִשְׁתֶּה עַל־כֵּן יָרִים רֹאשׁ׃
110.e: He will drink of the brook in the way; Therefore will he lift up the head.

111.s: הַלְלוּ יָהּ אוֹדֶה יְהוָה בְּכָל־לֵבָב בְּסוֹד יְשָׁרִים וְעֵדָה׃
111.e: Hallelujah. I will give thanks unto the LORD with my whole heart, . In the council of the upright, and in the congregation.
The works of the LORD are great, Sought out of all them that have delight therein.
His work is glory and majesty; And His righteousness endureth for ever.

111.s: זֵכֶר עָשָׂה לְנִפְלְאֹתָיו חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְהוָה׃
111.e: He hath made a memorial for His wonderful works; The LORD is gracious and full of compassion.

111.s: טֶרֶף נָתַן לִירֵאָיו יִזְכֹּר לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ׃
111.e: He hath given food unto them that fear Him; He will ever be mindful of His covenant.

111.s: כֹּחַ מַעֲשָׂיו הִגִּיד לְעַמּוֹ לָתֵת לָהֶם נַחֲלַת גּוֹיִם׃
111.e: He hath declared to His people the power of His works, In giving them the heritage of the nations.

111.s: מַעֲשֵׂי יָדָיו אֱמֶת וּמִשְׁפָּט נֶאֱמָנִים כָּל־פִּקּוּדָיו׃
111.e: The works of His hands are truth and justice; All His precepts are sure.

111.s: סְמוּכִים לָעַד לְעוֹלָם עֲשׂוּיִם בֶּאֱמֶת וְיָשָׁר׃
111.e: They are established for ever and ever, They are done in truth and uprightness.

111.s: פְּדוּת שָׁלַח לְעַמּוֹ צִוָּה־לְעוֹלָם בְּרִיתוֹ קָדוֹשׁ וְנוֹרָא שְׁמוֹ׃
111.e: He hath sent redemption unto His people; He hath commanded His covenant for ever; Holy and awful is His name.

111.s: רֵאשִׁית חָכְמָה יִרְאַת יְהוָה שֵׂכֶל טוֹב לְכָל־עֹשֵׂיהֶם תְּהִלָּתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד׃
111.e: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; A good understanding have all they that do thereafter; His praise endureth for ever.

112.s: הַלְלוּ יָהּ אַשְׁרֵי־אִישׁ יָרֵא אֶת־יְהוָה בְּמִצְוֺתָיו חָפֵץ מְאֹד׃
112.e: Hallelujah. Happy is the man that feareth the LORD, That delighteth greatly in His commandments.

112.s: גִּבּוֹר בָּאָרֶץ יִהְיֶה זַרְעוֹ דּוֹר יְשָׁרִים יְבֹרָךְ׃
112.e: His seed shall be mighty upon earth; The generation of the upright shall be blessed.
Wealth and riches are in his house; And his merit endureth for ever.

112.s: זָרַח בַּחֹשֶׁךְ אוֹר לַיְשָׁרִים חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם וְצַדִּיק׃
112.e: Unto the upright He shineth as a light in the darkness, Gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

112.s: טוֹב־אִישׁ חוֹנֵן וּמַלְוֶה יְכַלְכֵּל דְּבָרָיו בְּמִשְׁפָּט׃
112.e: Well is it with the man that dealeth graciously and lendeth, That ordereth his affairs rightfully.

112.s: כִּי־לְעוֹלָם לֹא־יִמּוֹט לְזֵכֶר עוֹלָם יִהְיֶה צַדִּיק׃
112.e: For he shall never be moved; The righteous shall be had in everlasting remembrance.

112.s: מִשְּׁמוּעָה רָעָה לֹא יִירָא נָכוֹן לִבּוֹ בָּטֻחַ בַּיהוָה׃
112.e: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings; His heart is stedfast, trusting in the LORD.

112.s: סָמוּךְ לִבּוֹ לֹא יִירָא עַד אֲשֶׁר־יִרְאֶה בְצָרָיו׃
112.e: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, Until he gaze upon his adversaries.

112.s: פִּזַּר נָתַן לָאֶבְיוֹנִים צִדְקָתוֹ עֹמֶדֶת לָעַד קַרְנוֹ תָּרוּם בְּכָבוֹד׃
112.e: He hath scattered abroad, he hath given to the needy; His righteousness endureth for ever; His horn shall be exalted in honour.

112.s: רָשָׁע יִרְאֶה וְכָעָס שִׁנָּיו יַחֲרֹק וְנָמָס תַּאֲוַת רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד׃
112.e: The wicked shall see it, and be vexed; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away; the desire of the wicked shall perish.

113.s: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַלְלוּ עַבְדֵי יְהוָה הַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה׃
113.e: Hallelujah. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, Praise the name of the LORD.

113.s: יְהִי שֵׁם יְהוָה מְבֹרָךְ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃
113.e: Blessed be the name of the LORD From this time forth and for ever.
From the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof The LORD'S name is to be praised.

113.s: רָם עַל־כָּל־גּוֹיִם יְהוָה עַל הַשָּׁמַיִם כְּבוֹדוֹ׃
113.e: The LORD is high above all nations, His glory is above the heavens.
Who is like unto the LORD our God, That is enthroned on high,
That looketh down low Upon heaven and upon the earth?

113.s: מְקִימִי מֵעָפָר דָּל מֵאַשְׁפֹּת יָרִים אֶבְיוֹן׃
113.e: Who raiseth up the poor out of the dust, And lifteth up the needy out of the dunghill;
That He may set him with princes, Even with the princes of His people.

113.s: מוֹשִׁיבִי עֲקֶרֶת הַבַּיִת אֵם־הַבָּנִים שְׂמֵחָה הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
113.e: Who maketh the barren woman to dwell in her house As a joyful mother of children. Hallelujah.

114.s: בְּצֵאת יִשְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָיִם בֵּית יַעֲקֹב מֵעַם לֹעֵז׃
114.e: When Israel came forth out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
Judah became His sanctuary, Israel His dominion.

114.s: הַיָּם רָאָה וַיָּנֹס הַיַּרְדֵּן יִסֹּב לְאָחוֹר׃
114.e: The sea saw it, and fled; The Jordan turned backward.
The mountains skipped like rams, The hills like young sheep.

114.s: מַה־לְּךָ הַיָּם כִּי תָנוּס הַיַּרְדֵּן תִּסֹּב לְאָחוֹר׃
114.e: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? Thou Jordan, that thou turnest backward?
Ye mountains, that ye skip like rams; Ye hills, like young sheep?

114.s: מִלִּפְנֵי אָדוֹן חוּלִי אָרֶץ מִלִּפְנֵי אֱלוֹהַּ יַעֲקֹב׃
114.e: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob;
Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of waters.

115.s: לֹא לָנוּ יְהוָה לֹא לָנוּ כִּי־לְשִׁמְךָ תֵּן כָּבוֹד עַל־חַסְדְּךָ עַל־אֲמִתֶּךָ׃
115.e: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, But unto Thy name give glory, For Thy mercy, and for Thy truth's sake.
Wherefore should the nations say: 'Where is now their God?'
But our God is in the heavens; Whatsoever pleased Him He hath done.

115.s: עֲ‍צַבֵּיהֶם כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָם׃
115.e: Their idols are silver and gold, The work of men's hands.

115.s: פֶּה־לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ עֵינַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאוּ׃
115.e: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;

115.s: אָזְנַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִשְׁמָעוּ אַף לָהֶם וְלֹא יְרִיחוּן׃
115.e: They have ears, but they hear not; Noses have they, but they smell not;

115.s: יְדֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְמִישׁוּן רַגְלֵיהֶם וְלֹא יְהַלֵּכוּ לֹא־יֶהְגּוּ בִּגְרוֹנָם׃
115.e: They have hands, but they handle not; Feet have they, but they walk not; Neither speak they with their throat. .

115.s: כְּמוֹהֶם יִהְיוּ עֹשֵׂיהֶם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵחַ בָּהֶם׃
115.e: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.

115.s: יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּטַח בַּיהוָה עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא׃
115.e: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD! He is their help and their shield!

115.s: בֵּית אַהֲרֹן בִּטְחוּ בַיהוָה עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא׃
115.e: O house of Aaron, trust ye in the LORD! He is their help and their shield!

115.s: יִרְאֵי יְהוָה בִּטְחוּ בַיהוָה עֶזְרָם וּמָגִנָּם הוּא׃
115.e: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

115.s: יְהוָה זְכָרָנוּ יְבָרֵךְ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל יְבָרֵךְ אֶת־בֵּית אַהֲרֹן׃
115.e: The LORD hath been mindful of us, He will bless— He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron.
He will bless them that fear the LORD, Both small and great.
The LORD increase you more and more, You and your children.

115.s: בְּרוּכִים אַתֶּם לַיהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃
115.e: Blessed be ye of the LORD Who made heaven and earth.

115.s: הַשָּׁמַיִם שָׁמַיִם לַיהוָה וְהָאָרֶץ נָתַן לִבְנֵי־אָדָם׃
115.e: The heavens are the heavens of the LORD; But the earth hath He given to the children of men.

115.s: לֹא הַמֵּתִים יְהַלְלוּ־יָהּ וְלֹא כָּל־יֹרְדֵי דוּמָה׃
115.e: The dead praise not the LORD, Neither any that go down into silence;

115.s: וַאֲנַחְנוּ נְבָרֵךְ יָהּ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
115.e: But we will bless the LORD From this time forth and for ever. Hallelujah.

116.e: I love that the LORD should hear my voice and my supplications.
Because He hath inclined His ear unto me, Therefore will I call upon Him all my days.

116.s: אֲפָפוּנִי חֶבְלֵי־מָוֶת וּמְצָרֵי שְׁאוֹל מְצָאוּנִי צָרָה וְיָגוֹן אֶמְצָא׃
116.e: The cords of death compassed me, And the straits of the nether-world got hold upon me; I found trouble and sorrow.

116.s: וּבְשֵׁם־יְהוָה אֶקְרָא אָנָּה יְהוָה מַלְּטָה נַפְשִׁי׃
116.e: But I called upon the name of the LORD: 'I beseech thee, O LORD, deliver my soul.'
Gracious is the LORD, and righteous; Yea, our God is compassionate.

116.s: שֹׁמֵר פְּתָאיִם יְהֹוָה דַּלּוֹתִי וְלִי יְהוֹשִׁיעַ׃
116.e: The LORD preserveth the simple; I was brought low, and He saved me.

116.s: שׁוּבִי נַפְשִׁי לִמְנוּחָיְכִי כִּי־יְהוָה גָּמַל עָלָיְכִי׃
116.e: Return, O my soul, unto Thy rest; For the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.

116.s: כִּי חִלַּצְתָּ נַפְשִׁי מִמָּוֶת אֶת־עֵינִי מִן־דִּמְעָה אֶת־רַגְלִי מִדֶּחִי׃
116.e: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, Mine eyes from tears, And my feet from stumbling.
I shall walk before the LORD In the lands of the living.

116.s: הֶאֱמַנְתִּי כִּי אֲדַבֵּר אֲנִי עָנִיתִי מְאֹד׃
116.e: I trusted even when I spoke: 'I am greatly afflicted.'
I said in my haste: 'All men are liars.'
How can I repay unto the LORD All His bountiful dealings toward me?
I will lift up the cup of salvation, And call upon the name of the LORD.
My vows will I pay unto the LORD, Yea, in the presence of all His people.
Precious in the sight of the LORD Is the death of His saints.

116.s: אָנָּה יְהוָה כִּי־אֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ אֲ‍נִי־עַבְדְּךָ בֶּן־אֲמָתֶךָ פִּתַּחְתָּ לְמוֹסֵרָי׃
116.e: I beseech Thee, O LORD, for I am Thy servant; I am Thy servant, the son of Thy handmaid; Thou hast loosed my bands.

116.s: לְךָ־אֶזְבַּח זֶבַח תּוֹדָה וּבְשֵׁם יְהוָה אֶקְרָא׃
116.e: I will offer to thee the sacrifice of thanksgiving, And will call upon the name of the LORD.
I will pay my vows unto the LORD, Yea, in the presence of all His people;

116.s: בְּחַצְרוֹת בֵּית יְהוָה בְּתוֹכֵכִי יְרוּשָׁלִָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
116.e: In the courts of the LORD’S house, In the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah.

117.e: O praise the LORD, all ye nations; Laud Him, all ye peoples.

117.s: כִּי גָבַר עָלֵינוּ חַסְדּוֹ וֶאֱמֶת־יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
117.e: For His mercy is great toward us; And the truth of the LORD endureth for ever. Hallelujah.

118.s: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
118.e: 'O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever.

118.s: יֹאמַר־נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
118.e: So let Israel now say, For His mercy endureth for ever,

118.s: יֹאמְרוּ־נָא בֵית־אַהֲרֹן כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
118.e: So let the house of Aaron now say, For His mercy endureth for ever.

118.s: יֹאמְרוּ־נָא יִרְאֵי יְהוָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
118.e: So let them now that fear the LORD say, For His mercy endureth for ever.

118.s: מִן־הַמֵּצַר קָרָאתִי יָּהּ עָנָנִי בַמֶּרְחָב יָהּ׃
118.e: Out of my straits I called upon the LORD; He answered me with great enlargement.

118.s: יְהוָה לִי לֹא אִירָא מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂה לִי אָדָם׃
118.e: The LORD is for me; I will not fear; What can man do unto me?

118.s: יְהוָה לִי בְּעֹזְרָי וַאֲנִי אֶרְאֶה בְשֹׂנְאָי׃
118.e: The LORD is for me as my helper; And I shall gaze upon them that hate me.

118.s: טוֹב לַחֲסוֹת בַּיהוָה מִבְּטֹחַ בָּאָדָם׃
118.e: It is better to take refuge in the LORD Than to trust in man.

118.s: טוֹב לַחֲסוֹת בַּיהוָה מִבְּטֹחַ בִּנְדִיבִים׃
118.e: It is better to take refuge in the LORD Than to trust in princes.

118.s: כָּל־גּוֹיִם סְבָבוּנִי בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי אֲמִילַם׃
118.e: All nations compass me about; Verily, in the name of the LORD I will cut them off.

118.s: סַבּוּנִי גַם־סְבָבוּנִי בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי אֲמִילַם׃
118.e: They compass me about, yea, they compass me about; Verily, in the name of the LORD I will cut them off.

118.s: סַבּוּנִי כִדְבוֹרִים דֹּעֲכוּ כְּאֵשׁ קוֹצִים בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי אֲמִילַם׃
118.e: They compass me about like bees; They are quenched as the fire of thorns; Verily, in the name of the LORD I will cut them off.

118.s: דַּחֹה דְחִיתַנִי לִנְפֹּל וַיהוָה עֲזָרָנִי׃
118.e: Thou didst thrust sore at me that I might fall; But the LORD helped me.

118.s: עָזִּי וְזִמְרָת יָהּ וַיְהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה׃
118.e: The LORD is my strength and song; And He is become my salvation.

118.s: קוֹל רִנָּה וִישׁוּעָה בְּאָהֳלֵי צַדִּיקִים יְמִין יְהוָה עֹשָׂה חָיִל׃
118.e: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous; The right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

118.s: יְמִין יְהוָה רוֹמֵמָה יְמִין יְהוָה עֹשָׂה חָיִל׃
118.e: The right hand of the LORD is exalted; The right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.

118.s: לֹא אָמוּת כִּי־אֶחְיֶה וַאֲסַפֵּר מַעֲשֵׂי יָהּ׃
118.e: I shall not die, but live, And declare the works of the LORD.

118.s: יַסֹּר יִסְּרַנִּי יָּהּ וְלַמָּוֶת לֹא נְתָנָנִי׃
118.e: The LORD hath chastened me sore; But He hath not given me over unto death.

118.s: פִּתְחוּ־לִי שַׁעֲרֵי־צֶדֶק אָבֹא־בָם אוֹדֶה יָהּ׃
118.e: Open to me the gates of righteousness; I will enter into them, I will give thanks unto the LORD.

118.s: זֶה־הַשַּׁעַר לַיהוָה צַדִּיקִים יָבֹאוּ בוֹ׃
118.e: This is the gate of the LORD; The righteous shall enter into it.

118.s: אוֹדְךָ כִּי עֲנִיתָנִי וַתְּהִי־לִי לִישׁוּעָה׃
118.e: I will give thanks unto Thee, for Thou hast answered me, And art become my salvation.

118.s: אֶבֶן מָאֲסוּ הַבּוֹנִים הָיְתָה לְרֹאשׁ פִּנָּה׃
118.e: The stone which the builders rejected Is become the chief corner-stone.

118.s: מֵאֵת יְהוָה הָיְתָה זֹּאת הִיא נִפְלָאת בְּעֵינֵינוּ׃
118.e: This is the LORD’S doing; It is marvellous in our eyes.

118.s: זֶה־הַיּוֹם עָשָׂה יְהוָה נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בוֹ׃
118.e: This is the day which the LORD hath made; We will rejoice and be glad in it.

118.s: אָנָּא יְהוָה הוֹשִׁיעָה נָּא אָנָּא יְהוָה הַצְלִיחָה נָּא׃
118.e: We beseech Thee, O LORD, save now! We beseech Thee, O LORD, make us now to prosper!

118.s: בָּרוּךְ הַבָּא בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה בֵּרַכְנוּכֶם מִבֵּית יְהוָה׃
118.e: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the LORD; We bless you out of the house of the LORD.

118.s: אֵל יְהוָה וַיָּאֶר לָנוּ אִסְרוּ־חַג בַּעֲבֹתִים עַד־קַרְנוֹת הַמִּזְבֵּחַ׃
118.e: The LORD is God, and hath given us light; Order the festival procession with boughs, even unto the horns of the altar.

118.s: אֵלִי אַתָּה וְאוֹדֶךָּ אֱלֹהַי אֲרוֹמְמֶךָּ׃
118.e: Thou art my God, and I will give thanks unto Thee; Thou art my God, I will exalt Thee.

118.s: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
118.e: O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever.

119.e: ALEPH. Happy are they that are upright in the way, who walk in the law of the LORD.
Happy are they that keep His testimonies, that seek Him with the whole heart.
Yea, they do no unrighteousness; they walk in His ways.
Thou hast ordained Thy precepts, that we should observe them diligently.
Oh that my ways were directed to observe Thy statutes!
Then should I not be ashamed, when I have regard unto all Thy commandments.

119.s: אוֹדְךָ בְּיֹשֶׁר לֵבָב בְּלָמְדִי מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
119.e: I will give thanks unto Thee with uprightness of heart, when I learn Thy righteous ordinances. .
I will observe Thy statutes; O forsake me not utterly.
BETH. Wherewithal shall a young man keep his way pure? By taking heed thereto according to Thy word.
With my whole heart have I sought Thee; O let me not err from Thy commandments.

119.s: בְּלִבִּי צָפַנְתִּי אִמְרָתֶךָ לְמַעַן לֹא אֶחֱטָא־לָךְ׃
119.e: Thy word have I laid up in my heart, that I might not sin against Thee.
Blessed art Thou, O LORD; Teach me Thy statutes.
With my lips have I told All the ordinances of Thy mouth.
I have rejoiced in the way of Thy testimonies, As much as in all riches.
I will meditate in Thy precepts, And have respect unto Thy ways.
I will delight myself in Thy statutes; I will not forget Thy word.
GIMEL. Deal bountifully with Thy servant that I may live, and I will observe Thy word.
Open Thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of Thy law.

119.s: גֵּר אָנֹכִי בָאָרֶץ אַל־תַּסְתֵּר מִמֶּנִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
119.e: I am a sojourner in the earth; hide not Thy commandments from me.
My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto Thine ordinances at all times.
Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, that do err from Thy commandments.

119.s: גַּל מֵעָלַי חֶרְפָּה וָבוּז כִּי עֵדֹתֶיךָ נָצָרְתִּי׃
119.e: Take away from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept Thy testimonies.

119.s: גַּם יָשְׁבוּ שָׂרִים בִּי נִדְבָּרוּ עַבְדְּךָ יָשִׂיחַ בְּחֻקֶּיךָ׃
119.e: Even though princes sit and talk against me, Thy servant doth meditate in Thy statutes.
Yea, Thy testimonies are my delight, they are my counsellors. DALETH.
My soul cleaveth unto the dust; quicken Thou me according to Thy word.
I told of my ways, and Thou didst answer me; teach me Thy statutes.
Make me to understand the way of Thy precepts, that I may talk of Thy wondrous works.
My soul melteth away for heaviness; sustain me according unto Thy word.
Remove from me the way of falsehood; and grant me Thy law graciously.
I have chosen the way of faithfulness; Thine ordinances have I set [before me].
I cleave unto Thy testimonies; O LORD, put me not to shame.
I will run the way of Thy commandments, For Thou dost enlarge my heart.

119.s: הוֹרֵנִי יְהוָה דֶּרֶךְ חֻקֶּיךָ וְאֶצְּרֶנָּה עֵקֶב׃
119.e: HE. Teach me, O LORD, the way of Thy statutes; And I will keep it at every step.
Give me understanding, that I keep Thy law and observe it with my whole heart.
Make me to tread in the path of Thy commandments; for therein do I delight.
Incline my heart unto Thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

119.s: הַעֲבֵר עֵינַי מֵרְאוֹת שָׁוְא בִּדְרָכֶךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
119.e: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity, and quicken me in Thy ways.
Confirm Thy word unto Thy servant, which pertaineth unto the fear of Thee.

119.s: הַעֲבֵר חֶרְפָּתִי אֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתִּי כִּי מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ טוֹבִים׃
119.e: Turn away my reproach which I dread; for Thine ordinances are good.
Behold, I have longed after Thy precepts; quicken me in Thy righteousness.
VAV. Let Thy mercies also come unto me, O LORD, even Thy salvation, according to Thy word;
That I may have an answer for him that taunteth me; for I trust in Thy word.

119.s: וְאַל־תַּצֵּל מִפִּי דְבַר־אֱמֶת עַד־מְאֹד כִּי לְמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃
119.e: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I hope in Thine ordinances;
So shall I observe Thy law continually for ever and ever;
And I will walk at ease, for I have sought Thy precepts;

119.s: וַאֲדַבְּרָה בְעֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶגֶד מְלָכִים וְלֹא אֵבוֹשׁ׃
119.e: I will also speak of Thy testimonies before kings, and will not be ashamed.
And I will delight myself in Thy commandments, which I have loved.

119.s: וְאֶשָּׂא־כַפַּי אֶל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁר אָהָבְתִּי וְאָשִׂיחָה בְחֻקֶּיךָ׃
119.e: I will lift up my hands also unto Thy commandments, which I have loved; And I will meditate in Thy statutes.
ZAIN. Remember the word unto Thy servant, Because Thou hast made me to hope.

119.s: זֹאת נֶחָמָתִי בְעָנְיִי כִּי אִמְרָתְךָ חִיָּתְנִי׃
119.e: This is my comfort in my affliction, that Thy word hath quickened me.

119.s: זֵדִים הֱלִיצֻנִי עַד־מְאֹד מִתּוֹרָתְךָ לֹא נָטִיתִי׃
119.e: The proud have had me greatly in derision; yet have I not turned aside from Thy law.
I have remembered Thine ordinances which are of old, O LORD, and have comforted myself. .
Burning indignation hath taken hold upon me, because of the wicked that forsake Thy law.
Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

119.s: זָכַרְתִּי בַלַּיְלָה שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה וָאֶשְׁמְרָה תּוֹרָתֶךָ׃
119.e: I have remembered Thy name, O LORD, in the night, and have observed Thy law.
This I have had, that I have kept Thy precepts.
HETH. My portion is the LORD, I have said that I would observe Thy words.
I have entreated Thy favour with my whole heart; be gracious unto me according to Thy word.
I considered my ways, and turned my feet unto Thy testimonies.
I made haste, and delayed not, to observe Thy commandments.

119.s: חֶבְלֵי רְשָׁעִים עִוְּדֻנִי תּוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
119.e: The bands of the wicked have enclosed me; but I have not forgotten Thy law.

119.s: חֲצוֹת־לַיְלָה אָקוּם לְהוֹדוֹת לָךְ עַל מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
119.e: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto Thee because of Thy righteous ordinances.

119.s: חָבֵר אָנִי לְכָל־אֲשֶׁר יְרֵאוּךָ וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי פִּקּוּדֶיךָ׃
119.e: I am a companion of all them that fear Thee, and of them that observe Thy precepts.

119.s: חַסְדְּךָ יְהוָה מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ חֻקֶּיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃
119.e: The earth, O LORD, is full of Thy mercy; teach me Thy statutes.
TETH. Thou hast dealt well with Thy servant, O LORD, according unto Thy word.

119.s: טוּב טַעַם וָדַעַת לַמְּדֵנִי כִּי בְמִצְוֺתֶיךָ הֶאֱמָנְתִּי׃
119.e: Teach me good discernment and knowledge; for I have believed in Thy commandments.

119.s: טֶרֶם אֶעֱנֶה אֲנִי שֹׁגֵג וְעַתָּה אִמְרָתְךָ שָׁמָרְתִּי׃
119.e: Before I was afflicted, I did err; But now I observe Thy word.
