Thou art good, and doest good; Teach me Thy statutes.

119.s: טָפְלוּ עָלַי שֶׁקֶר זֵדִים אֲנִי בְּכָל־לֵב אֱצֹּר פִּקּוּדֶיךָ׃
119.e: The proud have forged a lie against me; But I with my whole heart will keep Thy precepts.

119.s: טָפַשׁ כַּחֵלֶב לִבָּם אֲנִי תּוֹרָתְךָ שִׁעֲשָׁעְתִּי׃
119.e: Their heart is gross like fat; But I delight in Thy law.
It is good for me that I have been afflicted, In order that I might learn Thy statutes.
The law of Thy mouth is better unto me Than thousands of gold and silver.

119.s: יָדֶיךָ עָשׂוּנִי וַיְכוֹנְנוּנִי הֲבִינֵנִי וְאֶלְמְדָה מִצְוֺתֶיךָ׃
119.e: JOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me; Give me understanding, that I may learn Thy commandments.

119.s: יְרֵאֶיךָ יִרְאוּנִי וְיִשְׂמָחוּ כִּי לִדְבָרְךָ יִחָלְתִּי׃
119.e: They that fear Thee shall see me and be glad, because I have hope in Thy word.

119.s: יָדַעְתִּי יְהוָה כִּי־צֶדֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ וֶאֱמוּנָה עִנִּיתָנִי׃
119.e: I know, O LORD, that Thy judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness Thou hast afflicted me. .
Let, I pray Thee, Thy lovingkindness be ready to comfort me, According to Thy promise unto Thy servant.
Let Thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live; for Thy law is my delight.

119.s: יֵבֹשׁוּ זֵדִים כִּי־שֶׁקֶר עִוְּתוּנִי אֲנִי אָשִׂיחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶיךָ׃
119.e: Let the proud be put to shame, for they have distorted my cause with falsehood; but I will meditate in Thy precepts.
Let those that fear Thee return unto me, and they that know Thy testimonies.

119.s: יְהִי־לִבִּי תָמִים בְּחֻקֶּיךָ לְמַעַן לֹא אֵבוֹשׁ׃
119.e: Let my heart be undivided in Thy statutes, in order that I may not be put to shame.
CAPH. My soul pineth for Thy salvation; in Thy word do I hope.

119.s: כָּלוּ עֵינַי לְאִמְרָתֶךָ לֵאמֹר מָתַי תְּנַחֲמֵנִי׃
119.e: Mine eyes fail for Thy word, Saying: 'When wilt Thou comfort me?'

119.s: כִּי־הָיִיתִי כְּנֹאד בְּקִיטוֹר חֻקֶּיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
119.e: For I am become like a wine-skin in the smoke; yet do I not forget Thy statutes.

119.s: כַּמָּה יְמֵי־עַבְדֶּךָ מָתַי תַּעֲשֶׂה בְרֹדְפַי מִשְׁפָּט׃
119.e: How many are the days of Thy servant? When wilt Thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

119.s: כָּרוּ־לִי זֵדִים שִׁיחוֹת אֲשֶׁר לֹא כְתוֹרָתֶךָ׃
119.e: The proud have digged pits for me, which is not according to Thy law.
All Thy commandments are faithful; they persecute me for nought; help Thou me.

119.s: כִּמְעַט כִּלּוּנִי בָאָרֶץ וַאֲנִי לֹא־עָזַבְתִּי פִקֻּודֶיךָ׃
119.e: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but as for me, I forsook not Thy precepts.
Quicken me after Thy lovingkindness, and I will observe the testimony of Thy mouth.
LAMED. For ever, O LORD, Thy word standeth fast in heaven.

119.s: לְדֹר וָדֹר אֱמוּנָתֶךָ כּוֹנַנְתָּ אֶרֶץ וַתַּעֲמֹד׃
119.e: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations; Thou hast established the earth, and it standeth.

119.s: לְמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְדוּ הַיּוֹם כִּי הַכֹּל עֲבָדֶיךָ׃
119.e: They stand this day according to Thine ordinances; for all things are Thy servants.

119.s: לוּלֵי תוֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָי אָז אָבַדְתִּי בְעָנְיִי׃
119.e: Unless Thy law had been my delight, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

119.s: לְעוֹלָם לֹא־אֶשְׁכַּח פִּקּוּדֶיךָ כִּי בָם חִיִּיתָנִי׃
119.e: I will never forget Thy precepts; for with them Thou hast quickened me.
I am Thine, save me; for I have sought Thy precepts.

119.s: לִי קִוּוּ רְשָׁעִים לְאַבְּדֵנִי עֵדֹתֶיךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָן׃
119.e: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me; but I will consider Thy testimonies.

119.s: לְכָל תִּכְלָה רָאִיתִי קֵץ רְחָבָה מִצְוָתְךָ מְאֹד׃
119.e: I have seen an end to every purpose; but Thy commandment is exceeding broad.
MEM. O how love I Thy law! It is my meditation all the day.

119.s: מֵאֹיְבַי תְּחַכְּמֵנִי מִצְוֺתֶךָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם הִיא־לִי׃
119.e: Thy commandments make me wiser than mine enemies: For they are ever with me.

119.s: מִכָּל־מְלַמְּדַי הִשְׂכַּלְתִּי כִּי עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ שִׂיחָה לִי׃
119.e: I have more understanding than all my teachers; For Thy testimonies are my meditation.
I understand more than mine elders, because I have keep Thy precepts.

119.s: מִכָּל־אֹרַח רָע כָּלִאתִי רַגְלָי לְמַעַן אֶשְׁמֹר דְּבָרֶךָ׃
119.e: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, in order that I might observe Thy word.
I have not turned aside from Thine ordinances; For Thou hast instructed me.
How sweet are Thy words unto my palate! Yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

119.s: מִפִּקּוּדֶיךָ אֶתְבּוֹנָן עַל־כֵּן שָׂנֵאתִי כָּל־אֹרַח שָׁקֶר׃
119.e: From Thy precepts I get understanding; Therefore I hate every false way.
NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, And a light unto my path.
I have sworn, and have confirmed it, To observe Thy righteous ordinances.
I am afflicted very much; Quicken me, O LORD, according unto Thy word.

119.s: נִדְבוֹת פִּי רְצֵה־נָא יְהוָה וּמִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ לַמְּדֵנִי׃
119.e: Accept, I beseech Thee, the freewill-offerings of my mouth, O LORD, And teach me Thine ordinances.

119.s: נַפְשִׁי בְכַפִּי תָמִיד וְתוֹרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
119.e: My soul is continually in my hand; yet have I not forgotten Thy law.

119.s: נָתְנוּ רְשָׁעִים פַּח לִי וּמִפִּקּוּדֶיךָ לֹא תָעִיתִי׃
119.e: The wicked have laid a snare for me; yet went I not astray from Thy precepts.

119.s: נָחַלְתִּי עֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לְעוֹלָם כִּי־שְׂשׂוֹן לִבִּי הֵמָּה׃
119.e: Thy testimonies have I taken as a heritage for ever; for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

119.s: נָטִיתִי לִבִּי לַעֲשׂוֹת חֻקֶּיךָ לְעוֹלָם עֵקֶב׃
119.e: I have inclined my heart to perform Thy statutes, for ever, at every step.
SAMECH. I hate them that are of a double mind; but Thy law do I love.
Thou art my covert and my shield; in Thy word do I hope.
Depart from me, ye evildoers; that I may keep the commandments of my God.
Uphold me according unto Thy word, that I may live; and put me not to shame in my hope.
Support Thou me, and I shall be saved; and I will occupy myself with Thy statutes continually.
Thou hast made light of all them that err from Thy statutes; for their deceit is vain.

119.s: סִגִים הִשְׁבַּתָּ כָל־רִשְׁעֵי־אָרֶץ לָכֵן אָהַבְתִּי עֵדֹתֶיךָ׃
119.e: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross; therefore I love Thy testimonies.
My flesh shuddereth for fear of Thee; And I am afraid of Thy judgments.
AIN. I have done justice and righteousness; Leave me not to mine oppressors.
Be surety for Thy servant for good; Let not the proud oppress me.
Mine eyes fail for Thy salvation, and for Thy righteous word.
Deal with Thy servant according unto Thy mercy, and teach me Thy statutes.
I am Thy servant, give me understanding, that I may know Thy testimonies.
It is time for the LORD to work; They have made void Thy law.
Therefore I love Thy commandments Above gold, yea, above fine gold.

119.s: עַל־כֵּן כָּל־פִּקּוּדֵי כֹל יִשָּׁרְתִּי כָּל־אֹרַח שֶׁקֶר שָׂנֵאתִי׃
119.e: Therefore I esteem all [Thy] precepts concerning all things to be right; Every false way I hate.
PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful; Therefore doth my soul keep them.
The opening of Thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.
I opened wide my mouth, and panted; For I longed for Thy commandments.
Turn Thee towards me, and be gracious unto me, As is Thy wont to do unto those that love Thy name.
Order my footsteps by Thy word; And let not any iniquity have dominion over me.
Redeem me from the oppression of man, And I will observe Thy precepts.
Make Thy face to shine upon Thy servant; And teach me Thy statutes.

119.s: פַּלְגֵי־מַיִם יָרְדוּ עֵינָי עַל לֹא־שָׁמְרוּ תוֹרָתֶךָ׃
119.e: Mine eyes run down with rivers of water, Because they observe not Thy law.
TZADE. Righteous art Thou, O LORD, And upright are Thy judgments.
Thou hast commanded Thy testimonies in righteousness and exceeding faithfulness.
My zeal hath undone me, because mine adversaries have forgotten Thy words.
Thy word is tried to the uttermost, and Thy servant loveth it.

119.s: צָעִיר אָנֹכִי וְנִבְזֶה פִּקֻּדֶיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
119.e: I am small and despised; yet have I not forgotten Thy precepts.
Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and Thy law is truth.
Trouble and anguish have overtaken me; yet Thy commandments are my delight.
Thy testimonies are righteous for ever; give me understanding, and I shall live.

119.s: קָרָאתִי בְכָל־לֵב עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה חֻקֶּיךָ אֶצֹּרָה׃
119.e: KOPH. I have called with my whole heart; answer me, O LORD; I will keep Thy statutes.
I have called Thee, save me, and I will observe Thy testimonies.
I rose early at dawn, and cried; I hoped in Thy word.
Mine eyes forestalled the night-watches, that I might meditate in Thy word.

119.s: קוֹלִי שִׁמְעָה כְחַסְדֶּךָ יְהוָה כְּמִשְׁפָּטֶךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
119.e: Hear my voice according unto Thy lovingkindness; Quicken me, O LORD, as Thou art wont.
They draw nigh that follow after wickedness; they are far from Thy law.
Thou art nigh, O LORD; and all Thy commandments are truth.

119.s: קֶדֶם יָדַעְתִּי מֵעֵדֹתֶיךָ כִּי לְעוֹלָם יְסַדְתָּם׃
119.e: Of old have I known from Thy testimonies that Thou hast founded them for ever.
RESH. O see mine affliction, and rescue me; For I do not forget Thy law.
Plead Thou my cause, and redeem me; Quicken me according to Thy word.

119.s: רָחוֹק מֵרְשָׁעִים יְשׁוּעָה כִּי־חֻקֶּיךָ לֹא דָרָשׁוּ׃
119.e: Salvation is far from the wicked; For they seek not Thy statutes.
Great are Thy compassions, O LORD; Quicken me as Thou art wont.

119.s: רַבִּים רֹדְפַי וְצָרָי מֵעֵדְוֺתֶיךָ לֹא נָטִיתִי׃
119.e: Many are my persecutors and mine adversaries; Yet have I not turned aside from Thy testimonies.

119.s: רָאִיתִי בֹגְדִים וָאֶתְקוֹטָטָה אֲשֶׁר אִמְרָתְךָ לֹא שָׁמָרוּ׃
119.e: I beheld them that were faithless, and strove with them; Because they observed not Thy word.

119.s: רְאֵה כִּי־פִקּוּדֶיךָ אָהָבְתִּי יְהוָה כְּחַסְדְּךָ חַיֵּנִי׃
119.e: O see how I love Thy precepts; Quicken me, O LORD, according to Thy lovingkindness.
The beginning of Thy word is truth; And all Thy righteous ordinance endureth for ever.

119.s: שָׂרִים רְדָפוּנִי חִנָּם ומדבריך [וּמִדְּבָרְךָ] פָּחַד לִבִּי׃
119.e: SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause; But my heart standeth in awe of Thy words.

119.s: שָׂשׂ אָנֹכִי עַל־אִמְרָתֶךָ כְּמוֹצֵא שָׁלָל רָב׃
119.e: I rejoice at Thy word, As one that findeth great spoil.
I hate and abhor falsehood; Thy law do I love. .

119.s: שֶׁבַע בַּיּוֹם הִלַּלְתִּיךָ עַל מִשְׁפְּטֵי צִדְקֶךָ׃
119.e: Seven times a day do I praise Thee, because of Thy righteous ordinances.

119.s: שָׁלוֹם רָב לְאֹהֲבֵי תוֹרָתֶךָ וְאֵין־לָמוֹ מִכְשׁוֹל׃
119.e: Great peace have they that love Thy law; And there is no stumbling for them.
I have hoped for Thy salvation, O LORD, And have done Thy commandments.
My soul hath observed Thy testimonies; And I love them exceedingly.

119.s: שָׁמַרְתִּי פִקּוּדֶיךָ וְעֵדֹתֶיךָ כִּי כָל־דְּרָכַי נֶגְדֶּךָ׃
119.e: I have observed Thy precepts and Thy testimonies; For all my ways are before Thee.

119.s: תִּקְרַב רִנָּתִי לְפָנֶיךָ יְהוָה כִּדְבָרְךָ הֲבִינֵנִי׃
119.e: TAV. Let my cry come near before Thee, O LORD; Give me understanding according to Thy word.
Let my supplication come before Thee; deliver me according to Thy word.

119.s: תַּבַּעְנָה שְׂפָתַי תְּהִלָּה כִּי תְלַמְּדֵנִי חֻקֶּיךָ׃
119.e: Let my lips utter praise: Because Thou teachest me Thy statutes.

119.s: תַּעַן לְשׁוֹנִי אִמְרָתֶךָ כִּי כָל־מִצְוֺתֶיךָ צֶּדֶק׃
119.e: Let my tongue sing of Thy word; For all Thy commandments are righteousness.
Let Thy hand be ready to help me; For I have chosen Thy precepts.
I have longed for Thy salvation, O LORD; And Thy law is my delight.
Let my soul live, and it shall praise Thee; And let Thine ordinances help me.

119.s: תָּעִיתִי כְּשֶׂה אֹבֵד בַּקֵּשׁ עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי מִצְוֺתֶיךָ לֹא שָׁכָחְתִּי׃
119.e: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek Thy servant; For I have not forgotten Thy commandments.

120.s: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אֶל־יְהוָה בַּצָּרָתָה לִּי קָרָאתִי וַיַּעֲנֵנִי׃
120.e: A Song of Ascents. In my distress I called unto the LORD, And He answered me.

120.s: יְהוָה הַצִּילָה נַפְשִׁי מִשְּׂפַת־שֶׁקֶר מִלָּשׁוֹן רְמִיָּה׃
120.e: O LORD, deliver my soul from lying lips, From a deceitful tongue.

120.s: מַה־יִּתֵּן לְךָ וּמַה־יֹּסִיף לָךְ לָשׁוֹן רְמִיָּה׃
120.e: What shall be given unto thee, and what shall be done more unto thee, Thou deceitful tongue?

120.s: חִצֵּי גִבּוֹר שְׁנוּנִים עִם גַּחֲלֵי רְתָמִים׃
120.e: Sharp arrows of the mighty, With coals of broom.

120.s: אוֹיָה־לִי כִּי־גַרְתִּי מֶשֶׁךְ שָׁכַנְתִּי עִם־אָהֳלֵי קֵדָר׃
120.e: Woe is me, that I sojourn with Meshech, That I dwell beside the tents of Kedar!

120.s: רַבַּת שָׁכְנָה־לָּהּ נַפְשִׁי עִם שׂוֹנֵא שָׁלוֹם׃
120.e: My soul hath full long had her dwelling With him that hateth peace.
I am all peace; But when I speak, they are for war.

121.s: שִׁיר לַמַּעֲלוֹת אֶשָּׂא עֵינַי אֶל־הֶהָרִים מֵאַיִן יָבֹא עֶזְרִי׃
121.e: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: From whence shall my help come?

121.s: עֶזְרִי מֵעִם יְהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃
121.e: My help cometh from the LORD, Who made heaven and earth.
He will not suffer thy foot to be moved; He that keepeth thee will not slumber.

121.s: הִנֵּה לֹא־יָנוּם וְלֹא יִישָׁן שׁוֹמֵר יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
121.e: Behold, He that keepeth Israel Doth neither slumber nor sleep.

121.s: יְהוָה שֹׁמְרֶךָ יְהוָה צִלְּךָ עַל־יַד יְמִינֶךָ׃
121.e: The LORD is thy keeper; The LORD is thy shade upon thy right hand.
The sun shall not smite thee by day, Nor the moon by night.
The LORD shall keep thee from all evil; He shall keep thy soul.
The LORD shall guard thy going out and thy coming in, From this time forth and for ever.

122.s: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד שָׂמַחְתִּי בְּאֹמְרִים לִי בֵּית יְהוָה נֵלֵךְ׃
122.e: A Song of Ascents; of David. I rejoiced when they said unto me: 'Let us go unto the house of the LORD.'
Our feet are standing within thy gates, O Jerusalem;
Jerusalem, that art builded as a city that is compact together;

122.s: שֶׁשָּׁם עָלוּ שְׁבָטִים שִׁבְטֵי־יָהּ עֵדוּת לְיִשְׂרָאֵל לְהֹדוֹת לְשֵׁם יְהוָה׃
122.e: Whither the tribes went up, even the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony unto Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the LORD.

122.s: כִּי שָׁמָּה יָשְׁבוּ כִסְאוֹת לְמִשְׁפָּט כִּסְאוֹת לְבֵית דָּוִיד׃
122.e: For there were set thrones for judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
Pray for the peace of Jerusalem; May they prosper that love thee.
Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

122.s: לְמַעַן אַחַי וְרֵעָי אֲדַבְּרָה־נָּא שָׁלוֹם בָּךְ׃
122.e: For my brethren and companions' sakes, I will now say: 'Peace be within thee.'

122.s: לְמַעַן בֵּית־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֲבַקְשָׁה טוֹב לָךְ׃
122.e: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God I will seek thy good.

123.s: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אֵלֶיךָ נָשָׂאתִי אֶת־עֵינַי הַיֹּשְׁבִי בַּשָּׁמָיִם׃
123.e: A Song of Ascents. Unto Thee I lift up mine eyes, O Thou that art enthroned in the heavens.

123.s: הִנֵּה כְעֵינֵי עֲבָדִים אֶל־יַד אֲ‍דוֹנֵיהֶם כְּעֵינֵי שִׁפְחָה אֶל־יַד גְּבִרְתָּהּ כֵּן עֵינֵינוּ אֶל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַד שֶׁיְּחָנֵּנוּ׃
123.e: Behold, as the eyes of servants unto the hand of their master, As the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; So our eyes look unto the LORD our God, Until He be gracious unto us.

123.s: חָנֵּנוּ יְהוָה חָנֵּנוּ כִּי־רַב שָׂבַעְנוּ בוּז׃
123.e: Be gracious unto us, O LORD, be gracious unto us; For we are full sated with contempt.

123.s: רַבַּת שָׂבְעָה־לָּהּ נַפְשֵׁנוּ הַלַּעַג הַשַּׁאֲנַנִּים הַבּוּז לִגְאֵיוֹנִים׃
123.e: Our soul is full sated With the scorning of those that are at ease, And with the contempt of the proud oppressors.

124.s: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד לוּלֵי יְהוָה שֶׁהָיָה לָנוּ יֹאמַר־נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
124.e: A Song of Ascents; of David. 'If it had not been the LORD who was for us', Let Israel now say;

124.s: לוּלֵי יְהוָה שֶׁהָיָה לָנוּ בְּקוּם עָלֵינוּ אָדָם׃
124.e: 'If it had not been the LORD who was for us, When men rose up against us,

124.s: אֲזַי חַיִּים בְּלָעוּנוּ בַּחֲרוֹת אַפָּם בָּנוּ׃
124.e: Then they had swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us;

124.s: אֲזַי הַמַּיִם שְׁטָפוּנוּ נַחְלָה עָבַר עַל־נַפְשֵׁנוּ׃
124.e: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul;
Then the proud waters Had gone over our soul.'

124.s: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה שֶׁלֹּא נְתָנָנוּ טֶרֶף לְשִׁנֵּיהֶם׃
124.e: Blessed be the LORD, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

124.s: נַפְשֵׁנוּ כְּצִפּוֹר נִמְלְטָה מִפַּח יוֹקְשִׁים הַפַּח נִשְׁבָּר וַאֲנַחְנוּ נִמְלָטְנוּ׃
124.e: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers; The snare is broken, and we are escaped.

124.s: עֶזְרֵנוּ בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃
124.e: Our help is in the name of the LORD, Who made heaven and earth.

125.s: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת הַבֹּטְחִים בַּיהוָה כְּהַר־צִיּוֹן לֹא־יִמּוֹט לְעוֹלָם יֵשֵׁב׃
125.e: A Song of Ascents. They that trust in the LORD Are as mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abideth for ever.

125.s: יְרוּשָׁלִַם הָרִים סָבִיב לָהּ וַיהוָה סָבִיב לְעַמּוֹ מֵעַתָּה וְעַד־עוֹלָם׃
125.e: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, So the LORD is round about His people, From this time forth and for ever.

125.s: כִּי לֹא יָנוּחַ שֵׁבֶט הָרֶשַׁע עַל גּוֹרַל הַצַּדִּיקִים לְמַעַן לֹא־יִשְׁלְחוּ הַצַּדִּיקִים בְּעַוְלָתָה יְדֵיהֶם׃
125.e: For the rod of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; That the righteous put not forth their hands unto iniquity.
Do good, O LORD, unto the good, And to them that are upright in their hearts.

125.s: וְהַמַּטִּים עַקַלְקַלּוֹתָם יוֹלִיכֵם יְהוָה אֶת־פֹּעֲלֵי הָאָוֶן שָׁלוֹם עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
125.e: But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, The LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel.

126.s: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת בְּשׁוּב יְהוָה אֶת־שִׁיבַת צִיּוֹן הָיִינוּ כְּחֹלְמִים׃
126.e: A Song of Ascents. When the LORD brought back those that returned to Zion, We were like unto them that dream.

126.s: אָז יִמָּלֵא שְׂחוֹק פִּינוּ וּלְשׁוֹנֵנוּ רִנָּה אָז יֹאמְרוּ בַגּוֹיִם הִגְדִּיל יְהוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת עִם־אֵלֶּה׃
126.e: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing; then said they among the nations: 'The LORD hath done great things with these.'

126.s: הִגְדִּיל יְהוָה לַעֲשׂוֹת עִמָּנוּ הָיִינוּ שְׂמֵחִים׃
126.e: The LORD hath done great things with us; we are rejoiced.
Turn our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the dry land.
They that sow in tears Shall reap in joy.

126.s: הָלוֹךְ יֵלֵךְ וּבָכֹה נֹשֵׂא מֶשֶׁךְ־הַזָּרַע בֹּא־יָבוֹא בְרִנָּה נֹשֵׂא אֲלֻמֹּתָיו׃
126.e: Though he goeth on his way weeping that beareth the measure of seed, He shall come home with joy, bearing his sheaves.

127.s: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לִשְׁלֹמֹה אִם־יְהוָה לֹא־יִבְנֶה בַיִת שָׁוְא עָמְלוּ בוֹנָיו בּוֹ אִם־יְהוָה לֹא־יִשְׁמָר־עִיר שָׁוְא שָׁקַד שׁוֹמֵר׃
127.e: A Song of Ascents; of Solomon. Except the LORD build the house, They labour in vain that build it; Except the LORD keep the city, The watchman waketh but in vain.

127.s: שָׁוְא לָכֶם מַשְׁכִּימֵי קוּם מְאַחֲרֵי־שֶׁבֶת אֹכְלֵי לֶחֶם הָעֲצָבִים כֵּן יִתֵּן לִידִידוֹ שֵׁנָא׃
127.e: It is vain for you that ye rise early, and sit up late, Ye that eat the bread of toil; So He giveth unto His beloved in sleep.

127.s: הִנֵּה נַחֲלַת יְהוָה בָּנִים שָׂכָר פְּרִי הַבָּטֶן׃
127.e: Lo, children are a heritage of the LORD; The fruit of the womb is a reward.
As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, So are the children of one's youth.

127.s: אַשְׁרֵי הַגֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר מִלֵּא אֶת־אַשְׁפָּתוֹ מֵהֶם לֹא־יֵבֹשׁוּ כִּי־יְדַבְּרוּ אֶת־אוֹיְבִים בַּשָּׁעַר׃
127.e: Happy is the man that hath his quiver full of them; They shall not be put to shame, When they speak with their enemies in the gate.

128.s: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת אַשְׁרֵי כָּל־יְרֵא יְהוָה הַהֹלֵךְ בִּדְרָכָיו׃
128.e: A Song of Ascents. Happy is every one that feareth the LORD, That walketh in His ways.

128.s: יְגִיעַ כַּפֶּיךָ כִּי תֹאכֵל אַשְׁרֶיךָ וְטוֹב לָךְ׃
128.e: When thou eatest the labour of thy hands, Happy shalt thou be, and it shall be well with thee.

128.s: אֶשְׁתְּךָ כְּגֶפֶן פֹּרִיָּה בְּיַרְכְּתֵי בֵיתֶךָ בָּנֶיךָ כִּשְׁתִלֵי זֵיתִים סָבִיב לְשֻׁלְחָנֶךָ׃
128.e: Thy wife shall be as a fruitful vine, in the innermost parts of thy house; Thy children like olive plants, round about thy table.

128.s: הִנֵּה כִי־כֵן יְבֹרַךְ גָּבֶר יְרֵא יְהוָה׃
128.e: Behold, surely thus shall the man be blessed That feareth the LORD.

128.s: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן וּרְאֵה בְּטוּב יְרוּשָׁלִָם כֹּל יְמֵי חַיֶּיךָ׃
128.e: The LORD bless thee out of Zion; And see thou the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life;
And see thy children's children. Peace be upon Israel!

129.s: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת רַבַּת צְרָרוּנִי מִנְּעוּרַי יֹאמַר־נָא יִשְׂרָאֵל׃
129.e: A Song of Ascents. 'Much have they afflicted me from my youth up', Let Israel now say;

129.s: רַבַּת צְרָרוּנִי מִנְּעוּרָי גַּם לֹא־יָכְלוּ לִי׃
129.e: 'Much have they afflicted me from my youth up; But they have not prevailed against me.
The plowers plowed upon my back; They made long their furrows.
The LORD is righteous; He hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.'

129.s: יֵבֹשׁוּ וְיִסֹּגוּ אָחוֹר כֹּל שֹׂנְאֵי צִיּוֹן׃
129.e: Let them be ashamed and turned backward, All they that hate Zion.

129.s: יִהְיוּ כַּחֲצִיר גַּגּוֹת שֶׁקַּדְמַת שָׁלַף יָבֵשׁ׃
129.e: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, Which withereth afore it springeth up;

129.s: שֶׁלֹּא מִלֵּא כַפּוֹ קוֹצֵר וְחִצְנוֹ מְעַמֵּר׃
129.e: Wherewith the reaper filleth not his hand, Nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

129.s: וְלֹא אָמְרוּ הָעֹבְרִים בִּרְכַּת־יְהוָה אֲלֵיכֶם בֵּרַכְנוּ אֶתְכֶם בְּשֵׁם יְהוָה׃
129.e: Neither do they that go by say: ‘The blessing of the LORD be upon you; We bless you in the name of the LORD.'

130.e: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths have I called Thee, O LORD.

130.s: אֲדֹנָי שִׁמְעָה בְקוֹלִי תִּהְיֶינָה אָזְנֶיךָ קַשֻּׁבוֹת לְקוֹל תַּחֲנוּנָי׃
130.e: Lord, hearken unto my voice; let Thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.
If Thou, LORD, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?
For with Thee there is forgiveness, that Thou mayest be feared.

130.s: קִוִּיתִי יְהוָה קִוְּתָה נַפְשִׁי וְלִדְבָרוֹ הוֹחָלְתִּי׃
130.e: I wait for the LORD, my soul doth wait, and in His word do I hope.

130.s: נַפְשִׁי לַאדֹנָי מִשֹּׁמְרִים לַבֹּקֶר שֹׁמְרִים לַבֹּקֶר׃
130.e: My soul waiteth for the Lord, more than watchmen for the morning; yea, more than watchmen for the morning.

130.s: יַחֵל יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יְהוָה כִּי־עִם־יְהוָה הַחֶסֶד וְהַרְבֵּה עִמּוֹ פְדוּת׃
130.e: O Israel, hope in the LORD; for with the LORD there is mercy, and with Him is plenteous redemption.
And He will redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

131.s: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד יְהוָה לֹא־גָבַהּ לִבִּי וְלֹא־רָמוּ עֵינַי וְלֹא־הִלַּכְתִּי בִּגְדֹלוֹת וּבְנִפְלָאוֹת מִמֶּנִּי׃
131.e: A Song of Ascents; of David. LORD, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty; Neither do I exercise myself in things too great, or in things too wonderful for me.

131.s: אִם־לֹא שִׁוִּיתִי וְדוֹמַמְתִּי נַפְשִׁי כְּגָמֻל עֲלֵי אִמּוֹ כַּגָּמֻל עָלַי נַפְשִׁי׃
131.e: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; Like a weaned child with his mother; My soul is with me like a weaned child.
O Israel, hope in the LORD From this time forth and for ever.

132.s: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת זְכוֹר־יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֵת כָּל־עֻנּוֹתוֹ׃
132.e: A Song of Ascents. LORD, remember unto David All his affliction;

132.s: אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּע לַיהוָה נָדַר לַאֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב׃
132.e: How he swore unto the LORD, And vowed unto the Mighty One of Jacob:

132.s: אִם־אָבֹא בְּאֹהֶל בֵּיתִי אִם־אֶעֱלֶה עַל־עֶרֶשׂ יְצוּעָי׃
132.e: ‘Surely I will not come into the tent of my house, Nor go up into the bed that is spread for me;
I will not give sleep to mine eyes, Nor slumber to mine eyelids;

132.s: עַד־אֶמְצָא מָקוֹם לַיהוָה מִשְׁכָּנוֹת לַאֲבִיר יַעֲקֹב׃
132.e: Until I find out a place for the LORD, A dwelling-place for the Mighty One of Jacob.'
Lo, we heard of it as being in Ephrath; We found it in the field of athe wood.
Let us go into His dwelling-place; Let us worship at His footstool. .

132.s: קוּמָה יְהוָה לִמְנוּחָתֶךָ אַתָּה וַאֲרוֹן עֻזֶּךָ׃
132.e: Arise, O LORD, unto Thy resting-place; Thou, and the ark of Thy strength.
Let Thy priests be clothed with righteousness; And let Thy saints shout for joy.

132.s: בַּעֲבוּר דָּוִד עַבְדֶּךָ אַל־תָּשֵׁב פְּנֵי מְשִׁיחֶךָ׃
132.e: For Thy servant David's sake Turn not away the face of Thine anointed.

132.s: נִשְׁבַּע־יְהוָה לְדָוִד אֱמֶת לֹא־יָשׁוּב מִמֶּנָּה מִפְּרִי בִטְנְךָ אָשִׁית לְכִסֵּא־לָךְ׃
132.e: The LORD swore unto David in truth; He will not turn back from it: 'Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

132.s: אִם־יִשְׁמְרוּ בָנֶיךָ בְּרִיתִי וְעֵדֹתִי זוֹ אֲלַמְּדֵם גַּם־בְּנֵיהֶם עֲדֵי־עַד יֵשְׁבוּ לְכִסֵּא־לָךְ׃
132.e: If thy children keep My covenant And My testimony that I shall teach them, Their children also for ever shall sit upon thy throne.'

132.s: כִּי־בָחַר יְהוָה בְּצִיּוֹן אִוָּהּ לְמוֹשָׁב לוֹ׃
132.e: For the LORD hath chosen Zion; He hath desired it for His habitation:
'This is My resting-place for ever; Here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

132.s: צֵידָהּ בָּרֵךְ אֲבָרֵךְ אֶבְיוֹנֶיהָ אַשְׂבִּיעַ לָחֶם׃
132.e: I will abundantly bless her provision; I will give her needy bread in plenty.

132.s: וְכֹהֲנֶיהָ אַלְבִּישׁ יֶשַׁע וַחֲסִידֶיהָ רַנֵּן יְרַנֵּנוּ׃
132.e: Her priests also will I clothe with salvation; And her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

132.s: שָׁם אַצְמִיחַ קֶרֶן לְדָוִד עָרַכְתִּי נֵר לִמְשִׁיחִי׃
132.e: There will I make a horn to shoot up unto David, There have I ordered a lamp for Mine anointed.

132.s: אוֹיְבָיו אַלְבִּישׁ בֹּשֶׁת וְעָלָיו יָצִיץ נִזְרוֹ׃
132.e: His enemies will I clothe with shame; But upon himself shall his crown shine.'

133.s: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת לְדָוִד הִנֵּה מַה־טּוֹב וּמַה־נָּעִים שֶׁבֶת אַחִים גַּם־יָחַד׃
133.e: A Song of Ascents; of David. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!

133.s: כַּשֶּׁמֶן הַטּוֹב עַל־הָרֹאשׁ יֹרֵד עַל־הַזָּקָן זְקַן־אַהֲרֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד עַל־פִּי מִדּוֹתָיו׃
133.e: It is like the precious oil upon the head, Coming down upon the beard; Even Aaron's beard, That cometh down upon the collar of his garments;

133.s: כְּטַל־חֶרְמוֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד עַל־הַרְרֵי צִיּוֹן כִּי שָׁם צִוָּה יְהוָה אֶת־הַבְּרָכָה חַיִּים עַד־הָעוֹלָם׃
133.e: Like the dew of Hermon, That cometh down upon the mountains of Zion; For there the LORD commanded the blessing, Even life for ever.

134.s: שִׁיר הַמַּעֲלוֹת הִנֵּה בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה כָּל־עַבְדֵי יְהוָה הָעֹמְדִים בְּבֵית־יְהוָה בַּלֵּילוֹת׃
134.e: A Song of Ascents. Behold, bless ye the LORD, all ye servants of the LORD, That stand in the house of the LORD in the night seasons.
Lift up your hands to the sanctuary, And bless ye the LORD.

134.s: יְבָרֶכְךָ יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן עֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ׃
134.e: The LORD bless thee out of Zion; Even He that made heaven and earth.

135.s: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה הַלְלוּ עַבְדֵי יְהוָה׃
135.e: Hallelujah. Praise ye the name of the LORD; Give praise, O ye servants of the LORD,

135.s: שֶׁעֹמְדִים בְּבֵית יְהוָה בְּחַצְרוֹת בֵּית אֱלֹהֵינוּ׃
135.e: Ye that stand in the house of the LORD, In the courts of the house of our God.

135.s: הַלְלוּ־יָהּ כִּי־טוֹב יְהוָה זַמְּרוּ לִשְׁמוֹ כִּי נָעִים׃
135.e: Praise ye the LORD, for the LORD is good; Sing praises unto His name, for it is pleasant.

135.s: כִּי־יַעֲקֹב בָּחַר לוֹ יָהּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לִסְגֻלָּתוֹ׃
135.e: For the LORD hath chosen Jacob unto Himself, And Israel for His own treasure.

135.s: כִּי אֲנִי יָדַעְתִּי כִּי־גָדוֹל יְהוָה וַאֲדֹנֵינוּ מִכָּל־אֱלֹהִים׃
135.e: For I know that the LORD is great, And that our Lord is above all gods.

135.s: כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־חָפֵץ יְהוָה עָשָׂה בַּשָּׁמַיִם וּבָאָרֶץ בַּיַּמִּים וְכָל־תְּהוֹמוֹת׃
135.e: Whatsoever the LORD pleased, that hath He done, In heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;

135.s: מַעֲלֶה נְשִׂאִים מִקְצֵה הָאָרֶץ בְּרָקִים לַמָּטָר עָשָׂה מוֹצֵא־רוּחַ מֵאוֹצְרוֹתָיו׃
135.e: Who causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; He maketh lightnings for the rain; He bringeth forth the wind out of His treasuries.

135.s: שֶׁהִכָּה בְּכוֹרֵי מִצְרָיִם מֵאָדָם עַד־בְּהֵמָה׃
135.e: Who smote the first-born of Egypt, Both of man and beast.

135.s: שָׁלַח אֹתוֹת וּמֹפְתִים בְּתוֹכֵכִי מִצְרָיִם בְּפַרְעֹה וּבְכָל־עֲבָדָיו׃
135.e: He sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, Upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

135.s: שֶׁהִכָּה גּוֹיִם רַבִּים וְהָרַג מְלָכִים עֲצוּמִים׃
135.e: Who smote many nations, And slew mighty kings:

135.s: לְסִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי וּלְעוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן וּלְכֹל מַמְלְכוֹת כְּנָעַן׃
135.e: Sihon king of the Amorites, And Og king of Bashan, And all the kingdoms of Canaan;

135.s: וְנָתַן אַרְצָם נַחֲלָה נַחֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַמּוֹ׃
135.e: And gave their land for a heritage, A heritage unto Israel His people.

135.s: יְהוָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם יְהוָה זִכְרְךָ לְדֹר־וָדֹר׃
135.e: O LORD, Thy name endureth for ever; Thy memorial, O LORD, throughout all generations.

135.s: כִּי־יָדִין יְהוָה עַמּוֹ וְעַל־עֲבָדָיו יִתְנֶחָם׃
135.e: For the LORD will judge His people, And repent Himself for His servants.

135.s: עֲצַבֵּי הַגּוֹיִם כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב מַעֲשֵׂה יְדֵי אָדָם׃
135.e: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, The work of men's hands.

135.s: פֶּה־לָהֶם וְלֹא יְדַבֵּרוּ עֵינַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יִרְאוּ׃
135.e: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;

135.s: אָזְנַיִם לָהֶם וְלֹא יַאֲזִינוּ אַף אֵין־יֶשׁ־רוּחַ בְּפִיהֶם׃
135.e: They have ears, but they hear not; Neither is there any breath in their mouths.

135.s: כְּמוֹהֶם יִהְיוּ עֹשֵׂיהֶם כֹּל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵחַ בָּהֶם׃
135.e: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.

135.s: בֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה בֵּית אַהֲרֹן בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה׃
135.e: O house of Israel, bless ye the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless ye the LORD;

135.s: בֵּית הַלֵּוִי בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה יִרְאֵי יְהוָה בָּרֲכוּ אֶת־יְהוָה׃
135.e: O house of Levi, bless ye the LORD; Ye that fear the LORD, bless ye the LORD.

135.s: בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה מִצִּיּוֹן שֹׁכֵן יְרוּשָׁלִָם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
135.e: Blessed be the LORD out of Zion, Who dwelleth at Jerusalem. Hallelujah.

136.s: הוֹדוּ לַיהוָה כִּי־טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: O give thanks unto the LORD, for He is good, For His mercy endureth for ever. .

136.s: הוֹדוּ לֵאלֹהֵי הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: O give thanks unto the God of gods, For His mercy endureth for ever.

136.s: הוֹדוּ לַאֲדֹנֵי הָאֲדֹנִים כִּי לְעֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: O give thanks unto the Lord of lords, For His mercy endureth for ever.

136.s: לְעֹשֵׂה נִפְלָאוֹת גְּדֹלוֹת לְבַדּוֹ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: To Him who alone doeth great wonders, For His mercy endureth for ever.

136.s: לְעֹשֵׂה הַשָּׁמַיִם בִּתְבוּנָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: To Him that by understanding made the heavens, for His mercy endureth for ever.

136.s: לְרֹקַע הָאָרֶץ עַל־הַמָּיִם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: To Him that spread forth the earth above the waters, For His mercy endureth for ever.

136.s: לְעֹשֵׂה אוֹרִים גְּדֹלִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: To Him that made great lights, For His mercy endureth for ever;

136.s: אֶת־הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ לְמֶמְשֶׁלֶת בַּיּוֹם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: The sun to rule by day, For His mercy endureth for ever;

136.s: אֶת־הַיָּרֵחַ וְכוֹכָבִים לְמֶמְשְׁלוֹת בַּלָּיְלָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: The moon and stars to rule by night, For His mercy endureth for ever.

136.s: לְמַכֵּה מִצְרַיִם בִּבְכוֹרֵיהֶם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: To Him that smote Egypt in their first-born, For His mercy endureth for ever;

136.s: וַיּוֹצֵא יִשְׂרָאֵל מִתּוֹכָם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: And brought out Israel from among them, For His mercy endureth for ever;

136.s: בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וּבִזְרוֹעַ נְטוּיָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: With a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, For His mercy endureth for ever.

136.s: לְגֹזֵר יַם־סוּף לִגְזָרִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: To Him who divided the Red Sea in sunder, For His mercy endureth for ever;

136.s: וְהֶעֱבִיר יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּתוֹכוֹ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it, For His mercy endureth for ever;

136.s: וְנִעֵר פַּרְעֹה וְחֵילוֹ בְיַם־סוּף כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red Sea, For His mercy endureth for ever.

136.s: לְמוֹלִיךְ עַמּוֹ בַּמִּדְבָּר כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: To Him that led His people through the wilderness, For His mercy endureth for ever.

136.s: לְמַכֵּה מְלָכִים גְּדֹלִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: To Him that smote great kings; For His mercy endureth for ever;

136.s: וַיַּהֲרֹג מְלָכִים אַדִּירִים כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: And slew mighty kings, For His mercy endureth for ever.

136.s: לְסִיחוֹן מֶלֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִי כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: Sihon king of the Amorites, For His mercy endureth for ever;

136.s: וּלְעוֹג מֶלֶךְ הַבָּשָׁן כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: And Og king of Bashan, For His mercy endureth for ever;

136.s: וְנָתַן אַרְצָם לְנַחֲלָה כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: And gave their land for a heritage, For His mercy endureth for ever;

136.s: נַחֲלָה לְיִשְׂרָאֵל עַבְדּוֹ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: Even a heritage unto Israel His servant, For His mercy endureth for ever.

136.s: שֶׁבְּשִׁפְלֵנוּ זָכַר לָנוּ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: Who remembered us in our low estate, For His mercy endureth for ever;

136.s: וַיִּפְרְקֵנוּ מִצָּרֵינוּ כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: And hath delivered us from our adversaries, For His mercy endureth for ever.

136.s: נֹתֵן לֶחֶם לְכָל־בָּשָׂר כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: Who giveth food to all flesh, For His mercy endureth for ever.

136.s: הוֹדוּ לְאֵל הַשָּׁמָיִם כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ׃
136.e: O give thanks unto the God of heaven, For His mercy endureth for ever.

137.s: עַל נַהֲרוֹת בָּבֶל שָׁם יָשַׁבְנוּ גַּם־בָּכִינוּ בְּזָכְרֵנוּ אֶת־צִיּוֹן׃
137.e: By the rivers of Babylon, There we sat down, yea, we wept, When we remembered Zion.
Upon the willows in the midst thereof We hanged up our harps.

137.s: כִּי שָׁם שְׁאֵלוּנוּ שׁוֹבֵינוּ דִּבְרֵי־שִׁיר וְתוֹלָלֵינוּ שִׂמְחָה שִׁירוּ לָנוּ מִשִּׁיר צִיּוֹן׃
137.e: For there they that led us captive asked of us words of song, And our tormentors asked of us mirth: ‘Sing us one of the songs of Zion.'

137.s: אֵיךְ נָשִׁיר אֶת־שִׁיר־יְהוָה עַל אַדְמַת נֵכָר׃
137.e: How shall we sing the LORD’S song In a foreign land?
If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, Let my right hand forget her cunning.

137.s: תִּדְבַּק־לְשׁוֹנִי לְחִכִּי אִם־לֹא אֶזְכְּרֵכִי אִם־לֹא אַעֲלֶה אֶת־יְרוּשָׁלִַם עַל רֹאשׁ שִׂמְחָתִי׃
137.e: Let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth, If I remember thee not; If I set not Jerusalem Above my chiefest joy.

137.s: זְכֹר יְהוָה לִבְנֵי אֱדוֹם אֵת יוֹם יְרוּשָׁלִָם הָאֹמְרִים עָרוּ עָרוּ עַד הַיְסוֹד בָּהּ׃
137.e: Remember, O LORD, against the children of Edom The day of Jerusalem; Who said: 'Rase it, rase it, Even to the foundation thereof.'

137.s: בַּת־בָּבֶל הַשְּׁדוּדָה אַשְׁרֵי שֶׁיְשַׁלֶּם־לָךְ אֶת־גְּמוּלֵךְ שֶׁגָּמַלְתְּ לָנוּ׃
137.e: O daughter of Babylon, that art to be destroyed; Happy shall he be, that repayeth thee As thou hast served us.
Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones Against the rock.

138.s: לְדָוִד אוֹדְךָ בְכָל־לִבִּי נֶגֶד אֱלֹהִים אֲזַמְּרֶךָּ׃
138.e: [A Psalm] of David. I will give Thee thanks with my whole heart, In the presence of the mighty will I sing praises unto Thee.

138.s: אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶה אֶל־הֵיכַל קָדְשְׁךָ וְאוֹדֶה אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ עַל־חַסְדְּךָ וְעַל־אֲמִתֶּךָ כִּי־הִגְדַּלְתָּ עַל־כָּל־שִׁמְךָ אִמְרָתֶךָ׃
138.e: I will bow down toward Thy holy temple, And give thanks unto Thy name for Thy mercy and for Thy truth; For Thou hast magnified Thy word above all Thy name.

138.s: בְּיוֹם קָרָאתִי וַתַּעֲנֵנִי תַּרְהִבֵנִי בְנַפְשִׁי עֹז׃
138.e: In the day that I called, Thou didst answer me; Thou didst encourage me in my soul with strength.

138.s: יוֹדוּךָ יְהוָה כָּל־מַלְכֵי־אָרֶץ כִּי שָׁמְעוּ אִמְרֵי־פִיךָ׃
138.e: All the kings of the earth shall give Thee thanks, O LORD, For they have heard the words of Thy mouth.

138.s: וְיָשִׁירוּ בְּדַרְכֵי יְהוָה כִּי גָדוֹל כְּבוֹד יְהוָה׃
138.e: Yea, they shall sing of the ways of the LORD; For great is the glory of the LORD.

138.s: כִּי־רָם יְהוָה וְשָׁפָל יִרְאֶה וְגָבֹהַּ מִמֶּרְחָק יְיֵדָע׃
138.e: For though the LORD be high, yet regardeth He the lowly, And the haughty He knoweth from afar.

138.s: אִם־אֵלֵךְ בְּקֶרֶב צָרָה תְּחַיֵּנִי עַל אַף אֹיְבַי תִּשְׁלַח יָדֶךָ וְתוֹשִׁיעֵנִי יְמִינֶךָ׃
138.e: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, Thou quickenest me; Thou stretchest forth Thy hand against the wrath of mine enemies, And Thy right hand doth save me.

138.s: יְהוָה יִגְמֹר בַּעֲדִי יְהוָה חַסְדְּךָ לְעוֹלָם מַעֲשֵׂי יָדֶיךָ אַל־תֶּרֶף׃
138.e: The LORD will accomplish that which concerneth me; Thy mercy, O LORD, endureth for ever; Forsake not the work of Thine own hands.

139.s: לַמְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִד מִזְמוֹר יְהוָה חֲקַרְתַּנִי וַתֵּדָע׃
139.e: For the Leader. A Psalm of David. O LORD, Thou hast searched me, and known me. .

139.s: אַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ שִׁבְתִּי וְקוּמִי בַּנְתָּה לְרֵעִי מֵרָחוֹק׃
139.e: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, Thou understandest my thought afar off.

139.s: אָרְחִי וְרִבְעִי זֵרִיתָ וְכָל־דְּרָכַי הִסְכַּנְתָּה׃
139.e: Thou measurest my going about and my lying down, And art acquainted with all my ways.

139.s: כִּי אֵין מִלָּה בִּלְשׁוֹנִי הֵן יְהוָה יָדַעְתָּ כֻלָּהּ׃
139.e: For there is not a word in my tongue, But, lo, O LORD, Thou knowest it altogether.

139.s: אָחוֹר וָקֶדֶם צַרְתָּנִי וַתָּשֶׁת עָלַי כַּפֶּכָה׃
139.e: Thou hast hemmed me in behind and before, And laid Thy hand upon me.

139.s: פלאיה [פְּלִיאָה] דַעַת מִמֶּנִּי נִשְׂגְּבָה לֹא־אוּכַל לָהּ׃
139.e: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; Too high, I cannot attain unto it.

139.s: אָנָה אֵלֵךְ מֵרוּחֶךָ וְאָנָה מִפָּנֶיךָ אֶבְרָח׃
139.e: Whither shall I go from Thy spirit? Or whither shall I flee from Thy presence?

139.s: אִם־אֶסַּק שָׁמַיִם שָׁם אָתָּה וְאַצִּיעָה שְּׁאוֹל הִנֶּךָּ׃
139.e: If I ascend up into heaven, Thou art there; If I make my bed in the nether-world, behold, Thou art there.

139.s: אֶשָּׂא כַנְפֵי־שָׁחַר אֶשְׁכְּנָה בְּאַחֲרִית יָם׃
139.e: If I take the wings of the morning, And dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

139.s: גַּם־שָׁם יָדְךָ תַנְחֵנִי וְתֹאחֲזֵנִי יְמִינֶךָ׃
139.e: Even there would Thy hand lead me, And Thy right hand would hold me.

139.s: וָאֹמַר אַךְ־חֹשֶׁךְ יְשׁוּפֵנִי וְלַיְלָה אוֹר בַּעֲדֵנִי׃
139.e: And if I say: ‘Surely the darkness shall envelop me, And the light about me shall be night';

139.s: גַּם־חֹשֶׁךְ לֹא־יַחְשִׁיךְ מִמֶּךָ וְלַיְלָה כַּיּוֹם יָאִיר כַּחֲשֵׁיכָה כָּאוֹרָה׃
139.e: Even the darkness is not too dark for Thee, But the night shineth as the day; The darkness is even as the light.

139.s: כִּי־אַתָּה קָנִיתָ כִלְיֹתָי תְּסֻכֵּנִי בְּבֶטֶן אִמִּי׃
139.e: For Thou hast made my reins; Thou hast knit me together in my mother's womb.

139.s: אוֹדְךָ עַל כִּי נוֹרָאוֹת נִפְלֵיתִי נִפְלָאִים מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וְנַפְשִׁי יֹדַעַת מְאֹד׃
139.e: I will give thanks unto Thee, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made; Wonderful are Thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.

139.s: לֹא־נִכְחַד עָצְמִי מִמֶּךָּ אֲשֶׁר־עֻשֵּׂיתִי בַסֵּתֶר רֻקַּמְתִּי בְּתַחְתִּיּוֹת אָרֶץ׃
139.e: My frame was not hidden from Thee, When I was made in secret, And curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

139.s: גָּלְמִי רָאוּ עֵינֶיךָ וְעַל־סִפְרְךָ כֻּלָּם יִכָּתֵבוּ יָמִים יֻצָּרוּ ולא [וְלוֹ] אֶחָד בָּהֶם׃
139.e: Thine eyes did see mine unformed substance, And in Thy book they were all written— Even the days that were fashioned, When as yet there was none of them.

139.s: וְלִי מַה־יָּקְרוּ רֵעֶיךָ אֵל מֶה עָצְמוּ רָאשֵׁיהֶם׃
139.e: How weighty also are Thy thoughts unto me, O God! How great is the sum of them!

139.s: אֶסְפְּרֵם מֵחוֹל יִרְבּוּן הֱקִיצֹתִי וְעוֹדִי עִמָּךְ׃
139.e: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand; Were I to come to the end of them, I would still be with Thee.

139.s: אִם־תִּקְטֹל אֱלוֹהַּ רָשָׁע וְאַנְשֵׁי דָמִים סוּרוּ מֶנִּי׃
139.e: If Thou but wouldest slay the wicked, O God— Depart from me therefore, ye men of blood;

139.s: אֲשֶׁר יֹאמְרֻךָ לִמְזִמָּה נָשֻׂא לַשָּׁוְא עָרֶיךָ׃
139.e: Who utter Thy name with wicked thought, They take it for falsehood, even Thine enemies— .

139.s: הֲלוֹא־מְשַׂנְאֶיךָ יְהוָה אֶשְׂנָא וּבִתְקוֹמְמֶיךָ אֶתְקוֹטָט׃
139.e: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate Thee? And do not I strive with those that rise up against Thee?

139.s: תַּכְלִית שִׂנְאָה שְׂנֵאתִים לְאוֹיְבִים הָיוּ לִי׃
139.e: I hate them with utmost hatred; I count them mine enemies.

139.s: חָקְרֵנִי אֵל וְדַע לְבָבִי בְּחָנֵנִי וְדַע שַׂרְעַפָּי׃
139.e: Search me, O God, and know my heart, Try me, and know my thoughts;

139.s: וּרְאֵה אִם־דֶּרֶךְ־עֹצֶב בִּי וּנְחֵנִי בְּדֶרֶךְ עוֹלָם׃
139.e: And see if there be any way in me that is grievous, And lead me in the way everlasting.

140.e: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.

140.s: חַלְּצֵנִי יְהוָה מֵאָדָם רָע מֵאִישׁ חֲמָסִים תִּנְצְרֵנִי׃
140.e: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man; Preserve me from the violent man;

140.s: אֲשֶׁר חָשְׁבוּ רָעוֹת בְּלֵב כָּל־יוֹם יָגוּרוּ מִלְחָמוֹת׃
140.e: Who devise evil things in their heart; Every day do they stir up wars.

140.s: שָׁנֲנוּ לְשׁוֹנָם כְּמוֹ־נָחָשׁ חֲמַת עַכְשׁוּב תַּחַת שְׂפָתֵימוֹ סֶלָה׃
140.e: They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent; Vipers' venom is under their lips. Selah

140.s: שָׁמְרֵנִי יְהוָה מִידֵי רָשָׁע מֵאִישׁ חֲמָסִים תִּנְצְרֵנִי אֲשֶׁר חָשְׁבוּ לִדְחוֹת פְּעָמָי׃
140.e: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; Preserve me from the violent man; Who have purposed to make my steps slip.

140.s: טָמְנוּ־גֵאִים פַּח לִי וַחֲבָלִים פָּרְשׂוּ רֶשֶׁת לְיַד־מַעְגָּל מֹקְשִׁים שָׁתוּ־לִי סֶלָה׃
140.e: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; They have spread a net by the wayside; They have set gins for me. Selah

140.s: אָמַרְתִּי לַיהוָה אֵלִי אָתָּה הַאֲזִינָה יְהוָה קוֹל תַּחֲנוּנָי׃
140.e: I have said unto the LORD: 'Thou art my God'; Give ear, O LORD, unto the voice of my supplications.

140.s: יְהֹוִה אֲדֹנָי עֹז יְשׁוּעָתִי סַכֹּתָה לְרֹאשִׁי בְּיוֹם נָשֶׁק׃
140.e: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Who hast screened my head in the day of battle,

140.s: אַל־תִּתֵּן יְהוָה מַאֲוַיֵּי רָשָׁע זְמָמוֹ אַל־תָּפֵק יָרוּמוּ סֶלָה׃
140.e: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; Further not his evil device, so that they exalt themselves. Selah
As for the head of those that compass me about, Let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

140.s: ימיטו [יִמּוֹטוּ] עֲלֵיהֶם גֶּחָלִים בָּאֵשׁ יַפִּלֵם בְּמַהֲמֹרוֹת בַּל־יָקוּמוּ׃
140.e: Let burning coals fall upon them; Let them be cast into the fire, Into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

140.s: אִישׁ לָשׁוֹן בַּל־יִכּוֹן בָּאָרֶץ אִישׁ־חָמָס רָע יְצוּדֶנּוּ לְמַדְחֵפֹת׃
140.e: A slanderer shall not be established in the earth; The violent and evil man shall be hunted with thrust upon thrust.

140.s: ידעת [יָדַעְתִּי] כִּי־יַעֲשֶׂה יְהוָה דִּין עָנִי מִשְׁפַּט אֶבְיֹנִים׃
140.e: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the poor, And the right of the needy.

140.s: אַךְ צַדִּיקִים יוֹדוּ לִשְׁמֶךָ יֵשְׁבוּ יְשָׁרִים אֶת־פָּנֶיךָ׃
140.e: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto Thy name; The upright shall dwell in Thy presence.

141.s: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהוָה קְרָאתִיךָ חוּשָׁה לִּי הַאֲזִינָה קוֹלִי בְּקָרְאִי־לָךְ׃
141.e: A Psalm of David. LORD, I have called Thee; make haste unto me; Give ear unto my voice, when I call unto Thee.

141.s: תִּכּוֹן תְּפִלָּתִי קְטֹרֶת לְפָנֶיךָ מַשְׂאַת כַּפַּי מִנְחַת־עָרֶב׃
141.e: Let my prayer be set forth as incense before Thee, The lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

141.s: שִׁיתָה יְהוָה שָׁמְרָה לְפִי נִצְּרָה עַל־דַּל שְׂפָתָי׃
141.e: Set a guard, O LORD, to my mouth; Keep watch at the door of my lips.

141.s: אַל־תַּט־לִבִּי לְדָבָר רָע לְהִתְעוֹלֵל עֲלִלוֹת בְּרֶשַׁע אֶת־אִישִׁים פֹּעֲלֵי־אָוֶן וּבַל־אֶלְחַם בְּמַנְעַמֵּיהֶם׃
141.e: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, To be occupied in deeds of wickedness With men that work iniquity; And let me not eat of their dainties.

141.s: יֶהֶלְמֵנִי־צַדִּיק חֶסֶד וְיוֹכִיחֵנִי שֶׁמֶן רֹאשׁ אַל־יָנִי רֹאשִׁי כִּי־עוֹד וּתְפִלָּתִי בְּרָעוֹתֵיהֶם׃
141.e: Let the righteous smite me in kindness, and correct me; Oil so choice let not my head refuse; For still is my prayer because of their wickedness.

141.s: נִשְׁמְטוּ בִידֵי־סֶלַע שֹׁפְטֵיהֶם וְשָׁמְעוּ אֲמָרַי כִּי נָעֵמוּ׃
141.e: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock; And they shall hear my words, that they are sweet.

141.s: כְּמוֹ פֹלֵחַ וּבֹקֵעַ בָּאָרֶץ נִפְזְרוּ עֲצָמֵינוּ לְפִי שְׁאוֹל׃
141.e: As when one cleaveth and breaketh up the earth, Our bones are scattered at the grave's mouth.

141.s: כִּי אֵלֶיךָ יְהֹוִה אֲדֹנָי עֵינָי בְּכָה חָסִיתִי אַל־תְּעַר נַפְשִׁי׃
141.e: For mine eyes are unto Thee, O GOD the Lord; In Thee have I taken refuge, O pour not out my soul.

141.s: שָׁמְרֵנִי מִידֵי פַח יָקְשׁוּ לִי וּמֹקְשׁוֹת פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן׃
141.e: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, And from the gins of the workers of iniquity.

141.s: יִפְּלוּ בְמַכְמֹרָיו רְשָׁעִים יַחַד אָנֹכִי עַד־אֶעֱבוֹר׃
141.e: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, Whilst I withal escape.

142.e: Maschil of David, when he was in the cave; a Prayer.

142.s: קוֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָה אֶזְעָק קוֹלִי אֶל־יְהוָה אֶתְחַנָּן׃
142.e: With my voice I cry unto the LORD; With my voice I make supplication unto the LORD.

142.s: אֶשְׁפֹּךְ לְפָנָיו שִׂיחִי צָרָתִי לְפָנָיו אַגִּיד׃
142.e: I pour out my complaint before Him, I declare before Him my trouble;

142.s: בְּהִתְעַטֵּף עָלַי רוּחִי וְאַתָּה יָדַעְתָּ נְתִיבָתִי בְּאֹרַח־זוּ אֲהַלֵּךְ טָמְנוּ פַח לִי׃
142.e: When my spirit fainteth within me— Thou knowest my path— In the way wherein I walk Have they hidden a snare for me.

142.s: הַבֵּיט יָמִין וּרְאֵה וְאֵין־לִי מַכִּיר אָבַד מָנוֹס מִמֶּנִּי אֵין דּוֹרֵשׁ לְנַפְשִׁי׃
142.e: Look on my right hand, and see, For there is no man that knoweth me; I have no way to flee; No man careth for my soul.

142.s: זָעַקְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ יְהוָה אָמַרְתִּי אַתָּה מַחְסִי חֶלְקִי בְּאֶרֶץ הַחַיִּים׃
142.e: I have cried unto Thee, O LORD; I have said: 'Thou art my refuge, My portion in the land of the living.'

142.s: הַקְשִׁיבָה אֶל־רִנָּתִי כִּי־דַלּוֹתִי מְאֹד הַצִּילֵנִי מֵרֹדְפַי כִּי אָמְצוּ מִמֶּנִּי׃
142.e: Attend unto my cry; For I am brought very low; Deliver me from my persecutors; For they are too strong for me.

142.s: הוֹצִיאָה מִמַּסְגֵּר נַפְשִׁי לְהוֹדוֹת אֶת־שְׁמֶךָ בִּי יַכְתִּרוּ צַדִּיקִים כִּי תִגְמֹל עָלָי׃
142.e: Bring my soul out of prison, That I may give thanks unto Thy name; The righteous shall crown themselves because of me; For Thou wilt deal bountifully with me.

143.s: מִזְמוֹר לְדָוִד יְהוָה שְׁמַע תְּפִלָּתִי הַאֲזִינָה אֶל־תַּחֲנוּנַי בֶּאֱמֻנָתְךָ עֲנֵנִי בְּצִדְקָתֶךָ׃
143.e: A Psalm of David. O LORD, hear my prayer, give ear to my supplications; In Thy faithfulness answer me, and in Thy righteousness.

143.s: וְאַל־תָּבוֹא בְמִשְׁפָּט אֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ כִּי לֹא־יִצְדַּק לְפָנֶיךָ כָל־חָי׃
143.e: And enter not into judgment with Thy servant; For in Thy sight shall no man living be justified.

143.s: כִּי רָדַף אוֹיֵב נַפְשִׁי דִּכָּא לָאָרֶץ חַיָּתִי הוֹשִׁיבַנִי בְמַחֲשַׁכִּים כְּמֵתֵי עוֹלָם׃
143.e: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; He hath crushed my life down to the ground; He hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

143.s: וַתִּתְעַטֵּף עָלַי רוּחִי בְּתוֹכִי יִשְׁתּוֹמֵם לִבִּי׃
143.e: And my spirit fainteth within me; My heart within me is appalled.

143.s: זָכַרְתִּי יָמִים מִקֶּדֶם הָגִיתִי בְכָל־פָּעֳלֶךָ בְּמַעֲשֵׂה יָדֶיךָ אֲשׂוֹחֵחַ׃
143.e: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Thy doing; I muse on the work of Thy hands.

143.s: פֵּרַשְׂתִּי יָדַי אֵלֶיךָ נַפְשִׁי כְּאֶרֶץ־עֲיֵפָה לְךָ סֶלָה׃
143.e: I spread forth my hands unto Thee; My soul [thirsteth] after Thee, as a weary land. Selah

143.s: מַהֵר עֲנֵנִי יְהוָה כָּלְתָה רוּחִי אַל־תַּסְתֵּר פָּנֶיךָ מִמֶּנִּי וְנִמְשַׁלְתִּי עִם־יֹרְדֵי בוֹר׃
143.e: Answer me speedily, O LORD, My spirit faileth; Hide not Thy face from me; Lest I become like them that go down into the pit.

143.s: הַשְׁמִיעֵנִי בַבֹּקֶר חַסְדֶּךָ כִּי־בְךָ בָטָחְתִּי הוֹדִיעֵנִי דֶּרֶךְ־זוּ אֵלֵךְ כִּי־אֵלֶיךָ נָשָׂאתִי נַפְשִׁי׃
143.e: Cause me to hear Thy lovingkindness in the morning, For in Thee do I trust; Cause me to know the way wherein I should walk, For unto Thee have I lifted up my soul.
Deliver me from mine enemies, O LORD; With Thee have I hidden myself.

143.s: לַמְּדֵנִי לַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנֶךָ כִּי־אַתָּה אֱלוֹהָי רוּחֲךָ טוֹבָה תַּנְחֵנִי בְּאֶרֶץ מִישׁוֹר׃
143.e: Teach me to do Thy will, For Thou art my God; Let Thy good spirit Lead me in an even land.

143.s: לְמַעַן־שִׁמְךָ יְהוָה תְּחַיֵּנִי בְּצִדְקָתְךָ תוֹצִיא מִצָּרָה נַפְשִׁי׃
143.e: For Thy name's sake, O LORD, quicken me; In Thy righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.

143.s: וּבְחַסְדְּךָ תַּצְמִית אֹיְבָי וְהַאֲבַדְתָּ כָּל־צֹרֲרֵי נַפְשִׁי כִּי אֲנִי עַבְדֶּךָ׃
143.e: And in Thy mercy cut off mine enemies, And destroy all them that harass my soul; For I am Thy servant.

144.s: לְדָוִד בָּרוּךְ יְהוָה צוּרִי הַמְלַמֵּד יָדַי לַקְרָב אֶצְבְּעוֹתַי לַמִּלְחָמָה׃
144.e: [A Psalm] of David. Blessed be the LORD my Rock, Who traineth my hands for war, And my fingers for battle;

144.s: חַסְדִּי וּמְצוּדָתִי מִשְׂגַּבִּי וּמְפַלְטִי לִי מָגִנִּי וּבוֹ חָסִיתִי הָרוֹדֵד עַמִּי תַחְתָּי׃
144.e: My lovingkindness, and my fortress, My high tower, and my deliverer; My shield, and He in whom I take refuge; Who subdueth my people under me.
LORD, what is man, that Thou takest knowledge of him? Or the son of man, that Thou makest account of him?

144.s: אָדָם לַהֶבֶל דָּמָה יָמָיו כְּצֵל עוֹבֵר׃
144.e: Man is like unto a breath; His days are as a shadow that passeth away.

144.s: יְהוָה הַט־שָׁמֶיךָ וְתֵרֵד גַּע בֶּהָרִים וְיֶעֱשָׁנוּ׃
144.e: O LORD, bow Thy heavens, and come down; Touch the mountains, that they may smoke.

144.s: בְּרוֹק בָּרָק וּתְפִיצֵם שְׁלַח חִצֶּיךָ וּתְהֻמֵּם׃
144.e: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them; Send out Thine arrows, and discomfit them.

144.s: שְׁלַח יָדֶיךָ מִמָּרוֹם פְּצֵנִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי מִמַּיִם רַבִּים מִיַּד בְּנֵי נֵכָר׃
144.e: Stretch forth Thy hands from on high; Rescue me, and deliver me out of many waters, Out of the hand of strangers;

144.s: אֲשֶׁר פִּיהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁוְא וִימִינָם יְמִין שָׁקֶר׃
144.e: Whose mouth speaketh falsehood, And their right hand is a right hand of lying.

144.s: אֱ‍לֹהִים שִׁיר חָדָשׁ אָשִׁירָה לָּךְ בְּנֵבֶל עָשׂוֹר אֲזַמְּרָה־לָּךְ׃
144.e: O God, I will sing a new song unto Thee, Upon a psaltery of ten strings will I sing praises unto Thee;

144.s: הַנּוֹתֵן תְּשׁוּעָה לַמְּלָכִים הַפּוֹצֶה אֶת־דָּוִד עַבְדּוֹ מֵחֶרֶב רָעָה׃
144.e: Who givest salvation unto kings, Who rescuest David Thy servant from the hurtful sword.

144.s: פְּצֵנִי וְהַצִּילֵנִי מִיַּד בְּנֵי־נֵכָר אֲשֶׁר פִּיהֶם דִּבֶּר־שָׁוְא וִימִינָם יְמִין שָׁקֶר׃
144.e: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hand of strangers, Whose mouth speaketh falsehood, And their right hand is a right hand of lying.

144.s: אֲשֶׁר בָּנֵינוּ כִּנְטִעִים מְגֻדָּלִים בִּנְעוּרֵיהֶם בְּנוֹתֵינוּ כְזָוִיֹּת מְחֻטָּבוֹת תַּבְנִית הֵיכָל׃
144.e: We whose sons are as plants grown up in their youth; Whose daughters are as corner-pillars carved after the fashion of a palace;

144.s: מְזָוֵינוּ מְלֵאִים מְפִיקִים מִזַּן אֶל־זַן צֹאונֵנוּ מַאֲלִיפוֹת מְרֻבָּבוֹת בְּחוּצוֹתֵינוּ׃
144.e: Whose garners are full, affording all manner of store; Whose sheep increase by thousands and ten thousands in our fields;

144.s: אַלּוּפֵינוּ מְסֻבָּלִים אֵין־פֶּרֶץ וְאֵין יוֹצֵאת וְאֵין צְוָחָה בִּרְחֹבֹתֵינוּ׃
144.e: Whose oxen are well laden; With no breach, and no going forth, And no outcry in our broad places;

144.s: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁיֲהוָה אֱלֹהָיו׃
144.e: Happy is the people that is in such a case. Yea, happy is the people whose God is the LORD.

145.s: תְּהִלָּה לְדָוִד אֲרוֹמִמְךָ אֱלוֹהַי הַמֶּלֶךְ וַאֲבָרֲכָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
145.e: [A Psalm of] praise; of David. I will extol Thee, my God, O King; And I will bless Thy name for ever and ever.

145.s: בְּכָל־יוֹם אֲבָרֲכֶךָּ וַאֲהַלְלָה שִׁמְךָ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
145.e: Every day will I bless Thee; And I will praise Thy name for ever and ever.

145.s: גָּדוֹל יְהוָה וּמְהֻלָּל מְאֹד וְלִגְדֻלָּתוֹ אֵין חֵקֶר׃
145.e: Great is the LORD, and highly to be praised; And His greatness is unsearchable.

145.s: דּוֹר לְדוֹר יְשַׁבַּח מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וּגְבוּרֹתֶיךָ יַגִּידוּ׃
145.e: One generation shall laud Thy works to another, And shall declare Thy mighty acts.

145.s: הֲדַר כְּבוֹד הוֹדֶךָ וְדִבְרֵי נִפְלְאוֹתֶיךָ אָשִׂיחָה׃
145.e: The glorious splendour of Thy majesty, And Thy wondrous works, will I rehearse.

145.s: וֶעֱזוּז נוֹרְאֹתֶיךָ יֹאמֵרוּ וגדולתיך [וּגְדוּלָּתְךָ] אֲסַפְּרֶנָּה׃
145.e: And men shall speak of the might of Thy tremendous acts; And I will tell of Thy greatness.

145.s: זֵכֶר רַב־טוּבְךָ יַבִּיעוּ וְצִדְקָתְךָ יְרַנֵּנוּ׃
145.e: They shall utter the fame of Thy great goodness, And shall sing of Thy righteousness.

145.s: חַנּוּן וְרַחוּם יְהוָה אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וּגְדָל־חָסֶד׃
145.e: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; Slow to anger, and of great mercy.

145.s: טוֹב־יְהוָה לַכֹּל וְרַחֲמָיו עַל־כָּל־מַעֲשָׂיו׃
145.e: The LORD is good to all;  And His tender mercies are over all His works.

145.s: יוֹדוּךָ יְהוָה כָּל־מַעֲשֶׂיךָ וַחֲסִידֶיךָ יְבָרֲכוּכָה׃
145.e: All Thy works shall praise Thee, O LORD; And Thy saints shall bless Thee.

145.s: כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתְךָ יֹאמֵרוּ וּגְבוּרָתְךָ יְדַבֵּרוּ׃
145.e: They shall speak of the glory of Thy kingdom, And talk of Thy might;

145.s: לְהוֹדִיעַ לִבְנֵי הָאָדָם גְּבוּרֹתָיו וּכְבוֹד הֲדַר מַלְכוּתוֹ׃
145.e: To make known to the sons of men His mighty acts, And the glory of the majesty of His kingdom.

145.s: מַלְכוּתְךָ מַלְכוּת כָּל־עֹלָמִים וּמֶמְשֶׁלְתְּךָ בְּכָל־דּוֹר וָדוֹר׃
145.e: Thy kingdom is a kingdom for all ages, And Thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

145.s: סוֹמֵךְ יְהוָה לְכָל־הַנֹּפְלִים וְזוֹקֵף לְכָל־הַכְּפוּפִים׃
145.e: The LORD upholdeth all that fall, And raiseth up all those that are bowed down.

145.s: עֵינֵי־כֹל אֵלֶיךָ יְשַׂבֵּרוּ וְאַתָּה נוֹתֵן־לָהֶם אֶת־אָכְלָם בְּעִתּוֹ׃
145.e: The eyes of all wait for Thee, And Thou givest them their food in due season.

145.s: פּוֹתֵחַ אֶת־יָדֶךָ וּמַשְׂבִּיעַ לְכָל־חַי רָצוֹן׃
145.e: Thou openest Thy hand, And satisfiest every living thing with favour.

145.s: צַדִּיק יְהוָה בְּכָל־דְּרָכָיו וְחָסִיד בְּכָל־מַעֲשָׂיו׃
145.e: The LORD is righteous in all His ways, And gracious in all His works.

145.s: קָרוֹב יְהוָה לְכָל־קֹרְאָיו לְכֹל אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאֻהוּ בֶאֱמֶת׃
145.e: The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon Him, To all that call upon Him in truth.

145.s: רְצוֹן־יְרֵאָיו יַעֲשֶׂה וְאֶת־שַׁוְעָתָם יִשְׁמַע וְיוֹשִׁיעֵם׃
145.e: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear Him; He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

145.s: שׁוֹמֵר יְהוָה אֶת־כָּל־אֹהֲבָיו וְאֵת כָּל־הָרְשָׁעִים יַשְׁמִיד׃
145.e: The LORD preserveth all them that love Him; But all the wicked will He destroy.

145.s: תְּהִלַּת יְהוָה יְדַבֶּר־פִּי וִיבָרֵךְ כָּל־בָּשָׂר שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃
145.e: My mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD; And let all flesh bless His holy name for ever and ever.

146.e: Hallelujah. Praise the LORD, O my soul.

146.s: אֲהַלְלָה יְהוָה בְּחַיָּי אֲזַמְּרָה לֵאלֹהַי בְּעוֹדִי׃
146.e: I will praise the LORD while I live; I will sing praises unto my God while I have my being.

146.s: אַל־תִּבְטְחוּ בִנְדִיבִים בְּבֶן־אָדָם שֶׁאֵין לוֹ תְשׁוּעָה׃
146.e: Put not your trust in princes, Nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

146.s: תֵּצֵא רוּחוֹ יָשֻׁב לְאַדְמָתוֹ בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא אָבְדוּ עֶשְׁתֹּנֹתָיו׃
146.e: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his dust; In that very day his thoughts perish.

146.s: אַשְׁרֵי שֶׁאֵל יַעֲקֹב בְּעֶזְרוֹ שִׂבְרוֹ עַל־יְהוָה אֱלֹהָיו׃
146.e: Happy is he whose help is the God of Jacob, Whose hope is in the LORD his God,

146.s: עֹשֶׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ אֶת־הַיָּם וְאֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־בָּם הַשֹּׁמֵר אֱמֶת לְעוֹלָם׃
146.e: Who made heaven and earth, The sea, and all that in them is; Who keepeth truth for ever;

146.s: עֹשֶׂה מִשְׁפָּט לָעֲשׁוּקִים נֹתֵן לֶחֶם לָרְעֵבִים יְהוָה מַתִּיר אֲסוּרִים׃
146.e: Who executeth justice for the oppressed; Who giveth bread to the hungry. The LORD looseth the prisoners;

146.s: יְהוָה פֹּקֵחַ עִוְרִים יְהוָה זֹקֵף כְּפוּפִים יְהוָה אֹהֵב צַדִּיקִים׃
146.e: The LORD openeth the eyes of the blind; The LORD raiseth up them that are bowed down; The LORD loveth the righteous;

146.s: יְהוָה שֹׁמֵר אֶת־גֵּרִים יָתוֹם וְאַלְמָנָה יְעוֹדֵד וְדֶרֶךְ רְשָׁעִים יְעַוֵּת׃
146.e: The LORD preserveth the strangers; He upholdeth the fatherless and the widow; But the way of the wicked He maketh crooked.

146.s: יִמְלֹךְ יְהוָה לְעוֹלָם אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן לְדֹר וָדֹר הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
146.e: The LORD will reign for ever, Thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Hallelujah.

147.s: הַלְלוּ יָהּ כִּי־טוֹב זַמְּרָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ כִּי־נָעִים נָאוָה תְהִלָּה׃
147.e: Hallelujah; For it is good to sing praises unto our God; For it is pleasant, and praise is comely.

147.s: בּוֹנֵה יְרוּשָׁלִַם יְהוָה נִדְחֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל יְכַנֵּס׃
147.e: The LORD doth build up Jerusalem, He gathereth together the dispersed of Israel;

147.s: הָרֹפֵא לִשְׁבוּרֵי לֵב וּמְחַבֵּשׁ לְעַצְּבוֹתָם׃
147.e: Who healeth the broken in heart, And bindeth up their wounds.

147.s: מוֹנֶה מִסְפָּר לַכּוֹכָבִים לְכֻלָּם שֵׁמוֹת יִקְרָא׃
147.e: He counteth the number of the stars; He giveth them all their names.

147.s: גָּדוֹל אֲדוֹנֵינוּ וְרַב־כֹּחַ לִתְבוּנָתוֹ אֵין מִסְפָּר׃
147.e: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power; His understanding is infinite.

147.s: מְעוֹדֵד עֲנָוִים יְהוָה מַשְׁפִּיל רְשָׁעִים עֲדֵי־אָרֶץ׃
147.e: The LORD upholdeth the humble; He bringeth the wicked down to the ground.

147.s: עֱנוּ לַיהוָה בְּתוֹדָה זַמְּרוּ לֵאלֹהֵינוּ בְכִנּוֹר׃
147.e: Sing unto the LORD with thanksgiving, Sing praises upon the harp unto our God;

147.s: הַמְכַסֶּה שָׁמַיִם בְּעָבִים הַמֵּכִין לָאָרֶץ מָטָר הַמַּצְמִיחַ הָרִים חָצִיר׃
147.e: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, Who prepareth rain for the earth, Who maketh the mountains to spring with grass.

147.s: נוֹתֵן לִבְהֵמָה לַחְמָהּ לִבְנֵי עֹרֵב אֲשֶׁר יִקְרָאוּ׃
147.e: He giveth to the beast his food, And to the young ravens which cry.

147.s: לֹא בִגְבוּרַת הַסּוּס יֶחְפָּץ לֹא־בְשׁוֹקֵי הָאִישׁ יִרְצֶה׃
147.e: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse; He taketh no pleasure in the legs of a man.

147.s: רוֹצֶה יְהוָה אֶת־יְרֵאָיו אֶת־הַמְיַחֲלִים לְחַסְדּוֹ׃
147.e: The LORD taketh pleasure in them that fear Him, In those that wait for His mercy.

147.s: שַׁבְּחִי יְרוּשָׁלִַם אֶת־יְהוָה הַלְלִי אֱלֹהַיִךְ צִיּוֹן׃
147.e: Glorify the LORD, O Jerusalem; Praise thy God, O Zion.

147.s: כִּי־חִזַּק בְּרִיחֵי שְׁעָרָיִךְ בֵּרַךְ בָּנַיִךְ בְּקִרְבֵּךְ׃
147.e: For He hath made strong the bars of thy gates; He hath blessed thy children within thee.

147.s: הַשָּׂם־גְּבוּלֵךְ שָׁלוֹם חֵלֶב חִטִּים יַשְׂבִּיעֵךְ׃
147.e: He maketh thy borders peace; He giveth thee in plenty the fat of wheat.

147.s: הַשֹּׁלֵחַ אִמְרָתוֹ אָרֶץ עַד־מְהֵרָה יָרוּץ דְּבָרוֹ׃
147.e: He sendeth out His commandment upon earth; His word runneth very swiftly.

147.s: הַנֹּתֵן שֶׁלֶג כַּצָּמֶר כְּפוֹר כָּאֵפֶר יְפַזֵּר׃
147.e: He giveth snow like wool; He scattereth the hoar-frost like ashes.

147.s: מַשְׁלִיךְ קַרְחוֹ כְפִתִּים לִפְנֵי קָרָתוֹ מִי יַעֲמֹד׃
147.e: He casteth forth His ice like crumbs; Who can stand before His cold?

147.s: יִשְׁלַח דְּבָרוֹ וְיַמְסֵם יַשֵּׁב רוּחוֹ יִזְּלוּ־מָיִם׃
147.e: He sendeth forth His word, and melteth them; He causeth His wind to blow, and the waters flow.

147.s: מַגִּיד דברו [דְּבָרָיו] לְיַעֲקֹב חֻקָּיו וּמִשְׁפָּטָיו לְיִשְׂרָאֵל׃
147.e: He declareth His word unto Jacob, His statutes and His ordinances unto Israel.

147.s: לֹא עָשָׂה כֵן לְכָל־גּוֹי וּמִשְׁפָּטִים בַּל־יְדָעוּם הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
147.e: He hath not dealt so with any nation; And as for His ordinances, they have not known them. Hallelujah.

148.s: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַלְלוּ אֶת־יְהוָה מִן־הַשָּׁמַיִם הַלְלוּהוּ בַּמְּרוֹמִים׃
148.e: Hallelujah. Praise ye the LORD from the  heavens; Praise Him in the heights.
Praise ye Him, all His angels; Praise ye Him, all His hosts.

148.s: הַלְלוּהוּ שֶׁמֶשׁ וְיָרֵחַ הַלְלוּהוּ כָּל־כּוֹכְבֵי אוֹר׃
148.e: Praise ye Him, sun and moon; Praise Him, all ye stars of light.

148.s: הַלְלוּהוּ שְׁמֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם וְהַמַּיִם אֲשֶׁר מֵעַל הַשָּׁמָיִם׃
148.e: Praise Him, ye heavens of heavens, And ye waters that are above the heavens.

148.s: יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי הוּא צִוָּה וְנִבְרָאוּ׃
148.e: Let them praise the name of the LORD; For He commanded, and they were created.

148.s: וַיַּעֲמִידֵם לָעַד לְעוֹלָם חָק־נָתַן וְלֹא יַעֲבוֹר׃
148.e: He hath also established them for ever and ever; He hath made a decree which shall not be transgressed.
Praise the LORD from the earth, Ye sea-monsters, and all deeps;

148.s: אֵשׁ וּבָרָד שֶׁלֶג וְקִיטוֹר רוּחַ סְעָרָה עֹשָׂה דְבָרוֹ׃
148.e: Fire and hail, snow and vapour, Stormy wind, fulfilling His word;
Mountains and all hills, Fruitful trees and all cedars;
Beasts and all cattle, Creeping things and winged fowl;
Kings of the earth and all peoples, Princes and all judges of the earth;
Both young men and maidens, Old men and children;

148.s: יְהַלְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁם יְהוָה כִּי־נִשְׂגָּב שְׁמוֹ לְבַדּוֹ הוֹדוֹ עַל־אֶרֶץ וְשָׁמָיִם׃
148.e: Let them praise the name of the LORD, For His name alone is exalted; His glory is above the earth and heaven.

148.s: וַיָּרֶם קֶרֶן לְעַמּוֹ תְּהִלָּה לְכָל־חֲסִידָיו לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל עַם־קְרֹבוֹ הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
148.e: And He hath lifted up a horn for His people, A praise for all His saints, Even for the children of Israel, a people near unto Him. Hallelujah.

149.s: הַלְלוּ יָהּ שִׁירוּ לַיהוָה שִׁיר חָדָשׁ תְּהִלָּתוֹ בִּקְהַל חֲסִידִים׃
149.e: Hallelujah. Sing unto the LORD a new song, And His praise in the assembly of the saints.

149.s: יִשְׂמַח יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּעֹשָׂיו בְּנֵי־צִיּוֹן יָגִילוּ בְמַלְכָּם׃
149.e: Let Israel rejoice in his Maker; Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

149.s: יְהַלְלוּ שְׁמוֹ בְמָחוֹל בְּתֹף וְכִנּוֹר יְזַמְּרוּ־לוֹ׃
149.e: Let them praise His name in the dance; Let them sing praises unto Him with the timbrel and harp.

149.s: כִּי־רוֹצֶה יְהוָה בְּעַמּוֹ יְפָאֵר עֲנָוִים בִּישׁוּעָה׃
149.e: For the LORD taketh pleasure in His people; He adorneth the humble with salvation.
Let the saints exult in glory; Let them sing for joy upon their beds.

149.s: רוֹמְמוֹת אֵל בִּגְרוֹנָם וְחֶרֶב פִּיפִיּוֹת בְּיָדָם׃
149.e: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, And a two-edged sword in their hand;
To execute vengeance upon the nations, And chastisements upon the peoples;

149.s: לֶאְסֹר מַלְכֵיהֶם בְּזִקִּים וְנִכְבְּדֵיהֶם בְּכַבְלֵי בַרְזֶל׃
149.e: To bind their kings with chains, And their nobles with fetters of iron;

149.s: לַעֲשׂוֹת בָּהֶם מִשְׁפָּט כָּתוּב הָדָר הוּא לְכָל־חֲסִידָיו הַלְלוּ־יָהּ׃
149.e: To execute upon them the judgment written; He is the glory of all His saints. Hallelujah.

150.s: הַלְלוּ יָהּ הַלְלוּ־אֵל בְּקָדְשׁוֹ הַלְלוּהוּ בִּרְקִיעַ עֻזּוֹ׃
150.e: Hallelujah. Praise God in His sanctuary; Praise Him in the firmament of His power.
Praise Him for His mighty acts; Praise Him according to His abundant greatness.

150.s: הַלְלוּהוּ בְּתֵקַע שׁוֹפָר הַלְלוּהוּ בְּנֵבֶל וְכִנּוֹר׃
150.e: Praise Him with the blast of the horn; Praise Him with the psaltery and harp.

150.s: הַלְלוּהוּ בְתֹף וּמָחוֹל הַלְלוּהוּ בְּמִנִּים וְעוּגָב׃
150.e: Praise Him with the timbrel and dance; Praise Him with stringed instruments and the pipe.
Praise Him with the loud-sounding cymbals; Praise Him with the clanging cymbals.
Let every thing that hath breath praise the LORD. Hallelujah.
